This designation gives us greater flexibility in our programming, access to new funding opportunities and resources, and a reduced reporting and administrative burden. We're transforming our communications platform to a more robust system that enables us to better connect and grow. As we settle into the new platform we hope you will forgive our tests and trials. We're also actively working with and interviewing agencies that can help us develop more powerful strategies for promoting democratic values across rural Washington State. Over 80% of our neighbors in rural, Central and Eastern Washington have never heard a pro-democratic message! Please read to the bottom of this newsletter so we can reintroduce our Directors and Advisory Board members. | | | | | 📰 Do Facts Matter | 🧠 Why Understanding Matters I once studied under a professor who was a stickler for truly grasping concepts. He said, "If you can't describe a thing without using the name of the thing, you probably don't understand the thing." That lesson stuck with me. Now, as we face the relentless dismantling of our democracy and rule of law under 47, it's critical that we do understand--deeply and clearly--what we're fighting for. ⚖️ The Facts Divide If there's one stereotype that holds up, it's this: Democrats are obsessed with facts. MAGA, on the other hand, seems to have no use for them. This puts democrats at a disadvantage. While we're buried in research crafting careful rebuttals, the conversation has already moved on--and often the "truth" has been redefined without us. MAGA's strategy is simple: make bold, often outrageous claims without regard for the truth. This forces Democrats onto the defensive, tasked with disproving falsehoods instead of driving the narrative.That's a strategic failure we must correct. 🧭 The Role of Facts in Debate When I walk into a room, I want to be armed with the facts--cold, reliable, in my back pocket. But I also know that spitting out facts in the heat of a fiery exchange rarely moves hearts or minds. The facts are there for me--to make sure my statements won't come back to bite me. MAGA will lie, double down, and escalate. But as Democrats who believe in truth, civility, and respect, our words should ring true because they are true. 📌 Habeas Corpus, Latin Everyone Should Know. There are terms being thrown around today--like habeas corpus--that many people aren't familiar with. And yet, we must understand them. These aren't just academic ideas. They are essential tools in a democracy. Knowing what they mean gives us the confidence to speak up, push back, and defend our values in every conversation that matters. 🏛️ What Is Habeas Corpus? Habeas corpus is a legal right that protects people from being imprisoned without justification. It allows you to ask a court to decide whether your detention is lawful. If the government can't explain why you're being held, the court can order your release. It's one of our strongest safeguards against abuse of power. 📖 Abraham Lincoln Did What? In 1861, Abraham Lincoln suspended habeas corpus to allow the military to arrest suspected Confederate sympathizers without immediate court review. When Chief Justice Roger Taney ruled this unconstitutional--arguing only Congress had that authority--Lincoln ignored the decision. The clash sparked a major debate about presidential power during national emergencies, one that still echoes today. 📅 Modern Example: Guantanamo Bay After 9/11, the U.S. detained hundreds at Guantanamo Bay without charge. The Bush administration claimed these detainees had no legal right to challenge their imprisonment because they were held outside U.S. soil. But in 2008, the Supreme Court ruled in Boumediene v. Bush that habeas corpus does apply. Even in wartime, even at Guantanamo, the right to challenge unlawful detention still stands. 🛡️ Why This Still Matters Habeas corpus might sound technical--but it's anything but abstract. It's a firewall against tyranny. And in turbulent political times, those firewalls are the first targets. If we don't understand these terms, we risk losing the protections they represent. So yes, facts matter. They anchor us to truth, law, and justice. And the better we understand those facts--like what habeas corpus really means--the better equipped we are to protect democracy. | | == | | | Our Board | | | | | Doug White Director Doug is a fourth-generation farmer from Yakima, Washington, with a global career in project management. He's led large international teams, navigating complex goals and diverse perspectives to deliver projects on time and under budget. Doug brought those skills home when he ran for Congress, uniting Central Washington Democrats into a coordinated campaign for the first time. He raised more money than any candidate in district history, forced unprecedented spending from his opponent, and led the first bilingual campaign and forums in the region. Now, Doug focuses on building lasting political infrastructure. He believes strong organization--not just elections--is the key to lasting democratic success. | | | | | Maricela Sanchez, MD Director Maricela is a dedicated advocate for rural prosperity and community health. Born to a Mexican immigrant family in the Yakima Valley, she worked alongside her family as a migrant farm laborer--an experience that shaped her commitment to agriculture, education, and equity. She earned a degree in American Ethnic Studies from the University of Washington and taught through Teach for America in Los Angeles. Driven to make a broader impact, she went on to earn her medical degree from Stanford and completed her anesthesiology training at Columbia University. Now practicing at Kadlec Regional Medical Center in Richland, WA, Dr. Sanchez also serves on the Pasco City Council and the board of Heritage University. Her leadership bridges healthcare, education, and sustainable development in service to rural communities. | | | | | Shirley Grossman Advisory Board Member Shirley was a founding organizer of the Donkey Club in Eastern Washington. The Donkey Club is a pro-democratic values organization second in size only to the Spokane Democratic Party. Her connections up and down Congressional District 5 have proven instrumental in launching the Granny Caravan: Unity Road Tour. She is a consistent fundraiser for Rural Americans United and has started a legacy in honor of her late daughter Eve, with all proceeds going to Rural Americans United. Despite her exuberant spirit, Shirley faces deep challenges in her personal life. She has lost both her husband and a daughter and speaks of the prejudices she faces as a member of the Jewish faith. | | | | | Soneya Lund Advisory Board Member Soneya is a community leader and small business owner based in Yakima, Washington. As a former City Councilperson and Deputy Mayor, she combines her background in business and public service to address local challenges--especially housing insecurity and homelessness. She serves on multiple boards and committees, including the Yakima Planning Commission, Justice Housing Board, and the Yakima County Homeless Coalition Executive Committee. A graduate of Leadership Yakima and active member of the Rotary Club, Soneya is committed to building a stronger, more inclusive Yakima through advocacy, collaboration, and direct service. | | | | | Paul Tabayoyon Advisory Board Member Paul Tabayoyon is the Executive Director of APIC-Yakima (Asian Pacific Islander Coalition of Yakima) and a lifelong resident of Yakima, Washington. With a background in industrial automation and project management, Paul returned to school to earn a Bachelor of Applied Science in Integrated Energy Management from Central Washington University in 2019, building on earlier studies at Perry Tech and Yakima Valley College. Paul brings a systems-thinking approach to community advocacy, focused on equity, sustainability, and access to opportunity. He's committed to improving lives by expanding educational and civic engagement across Yakima's diverse communities. | | | | | Odalys Gonzalez Advisory Board Member Odalys is a community outreach coordinator for UFCW Local 21. She is known for her active community engagement, often at protests, marches, and community events supporting democratic values. Her passion for community education is commendable. Odalys' work to empower workers and establish fair compensation and respect for their contributions is important. She is unrelenting in her defense of workers. | | | | | Joshua Hastings Advisory Board Member Joshua (he/him) is an IT consultant, nonprofit leader, and LGBTQ+ advocate based in Yakima, WA, with roots in Wapato on the Yakama Reservation. His career spans roles at Microsoft, Kelley Blue Book, and Yakima Valley Farm Workers Clinic, with expertise in technology, digital communications, and design. As President and co-founder of Yakima Pride, Joshua has advanced LGBTQ+ advocacy across Central Washington. He also serves on the Advisory Board of Rural Americans United, where he brings a strong focus on inclusive representation, community empowerment, and digital strategy. | | | | | Kim Lehrman Advisory Board Member Kim is a dedicated educator, community leader, and advocate for inclusion based in Pasco, WA. Raised on a first-generation cattle and alfalfa farm in the Tri-Cities, she brings a unique rural perspective to her roles as a teacher, mother of four, and Vice Chair of the Pasco Planning Commission. With degrees in Agriculture Science and Educational Leadership, Kim has taught welding, agriculture, and CTE courses across local high schools. She has also been active in youth sports, school district planning, and civic engagement campaigns. Now an art instructor at Chiawana High School, Kim champions equity, safety, affordable housing, and community-driven development across Pasco. | | | | | Jayce Wright Advisory Board Member Jayce (he/him/his) born and raised in East Pasco, spent 10+ years in Seattle, have been back in the TriCities for nearly 10 years. Background working with at-risk, homeless, and LGBT+ youth, with work experience in and with schools and partnering non-profits. Director of Communications for our new and local NAACP Chapter 1135-B. Committed to community improvement and servant leadership. Believer in continued education/training and the powers of collaboration. Love to explore what great minds can create together! Soulja for the cause. | | | | | Ivy Murumbei Advisory Board Member My name is Ivy. I graduated from Southridge High School in 2024 through the Running Start program and am now pursuing a bachelor's degree in political science. I was born in Kitengela, Kenya, and moved to Dallas, Texas, when I was five. About four years ago, my family relocated to the Tri-Cities. Being from a developing country comes with challenges, but I've learned to embrace those experiences and carry the lessons with me. Kenya taught me the power of community, the value of gratitude, and the responsibility we have to one another. I believe uplifting those in need--locally and globally--is not a burden, but a privilege we should all strive to fulfill. | | | | | Bertha Alicia Garza Advisory Board Member Bertha Alicia has a dedicated career in community-based and grass-rooted organizations. Bertha Alicia Garza is the founder of La Oficina (CSC Yakima) a grass-rooted Business Resource Center. Prior to starting Centro de Servicios Comunitarios (CSC Yakima), she was employed for over a decade with a non-profit organization bringing youth college outreach and after-school programs to Central Washington school districts. She had co-founded a local business center where she was dealing with many Hispanic families that needed her assistance. As the CEO and founder of CSC Yakima, Bertha Alicia brings expertise in program development and management, strategic planning, and organizational development. Bertha Alicia is bilingual and bicultural and is extensively involved in minority leadership efforts in her community over the past 20 years. She strives to build alliances, break barriers, and culturally inclusive practices that create positive relati | | | | | Ana Ruiz-Kennedy Advisory Board Member Ana is a seasoned business liaison, community advocate, and recent candidate for Washington's Legislative District 14. With a background in marketing, financial services, and community development, Ana currently serves as a Business Liaison at Craft3, helping to drive equitable economic impact across the region. She has held key roles at Numerica Credit Union, Fiesta Foods, and New York Life, and served as Vice-Chair of the Washington State Commission on Hispanic Affairs, advising on issues affecting the Latino community. Ana's career began as a Spanish interpreter with Pacific Interpreters, where she spent over a decade bridging communication gaps. Her deep commitment to equity, economic opportunity, and public service defines her work and advocacy across Central Washington. | == == mailto:doug@ruralamericansunited.org Rural Americans United | | | | Rural Americans United | 420 South 72nd Avenue Suite 180 PMB 110 | Yakima, WA 98908 US | |

name: Tom Fitton
subject: Accountability…We Demand It and We Fight for It!
body:
Judicial Watch does not believe that election results should let government officials off the hook for violating the law... ...and I am urgently asking for your help today so that we can continue to hold officials from the Biden administration accountable under the law to the American people!

|
| |
---
|
---
|
---
| Dear Fellow American,

Judicial Watch does not believe that election results should let government officials off the hook for violating the law...
...and [I am _urgently_ asking for your help today](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=73999&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2) so that we can continue to hold officials from the Biden administration accountable under the law to the American people!
| [Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=73999&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)
---

Please let me briefly review three **Judicial Watch** lawsuits that you won't hear about in the mainstream media, but that are critically important to upholding the rule of law and creating accountability in government.

* Last month, _in response to a**Judicial Watch** lawsuit_, we received documents from the Justice Department showing that Biden White House staffers suggested edits to transcripts of **President Biden 's interview** with Special Counsel Robert Hur regarding his handling of secret documents.

These new documents provide an extraordinary insight into a **White House cover-up** of Biden's cognitive challenges. And we urge Trump Attorney General Pam Bondi to follow up with the **full release of the actual audio** of President Biden's disastrous interview with the special counsel, **which we are also suing for!**

[Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=73999&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)
---

* Also in April, we sued the **Justice Department** for emails of Dena Perkins, a section chief at the FBI, regarding whistleblower retaliation against FBI officials who were considered pro-Trump. Congressional testimony of multiple FBI agents indicates a _clear pattern of harassment_ of multiple FBI employees, including the suspension of security clearances and job loss, allegedly because of their support for Trump.

Our lawsuit shows that elements in the FBI are still covering up its mistreatment of these agents. **Transparency and accountability at the FBI can 't come soon enough!**

[Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=73999&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)
---

* And just two weeks ago, we sued the **Defense Department** for records regarding a reported January 2021 meeting between Attorney General Merrick Garland and Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff General Mark Milley during which they discussed President Trump, which journalist Bob Woodward described as "_highly unusual, if not unprecedented_."

We _know_ that General Milley abused his office to target President Trump and millions of Americans as he pursued the political agenda of the Biden administration. We urge Trump Defense Secretary Hegseth **to order immediate transparency** and release these documents to Judicial Watch and the American people!

We will never drain the Washington swamp if the American people are kept in the dark about government wrongdoing, whether by past or present administrations!

That's why we _persist_ in our litigation to advance accountability and the American people's "right to know."

But all our lawsuits cost money!

**[Please help us today with your best gift.](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=73999&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)** And I thank you in advance for giving **Judicial Watch** your support!

Sincerely,

Thomas Fitton
President

name: Keith Ellison
subject: I'm suing the Trump administration. Here's why.
disclaimer_text: paid for by the Keith Ellison for Attorney General committee, PO Box 17224, Minneapolis, MN 55417
body:
Peter,

Trump wants Minnesota law enforcement to step away from their jobs—patrolling, investigating crimes, and engaging with communities—and act as federal immigration agents instead.

And if our state refuses to do the federal government’s job, Trump is threatening to withhold important funding for disaster relief and public safety.

The Trump administration is threatening the safety of Minnesotans and trying to bully states into doing their dirty work. I won’t let that happen.

On Tuesday, I filed two lawsuits against the Trump administration. I’m leading a coalition of 19 attorneys general working to put a stop to Trump’s coercive, unlawful actions—and protect billions of dollars in funds for emergency services and infrastructure projects.

body:
Let us lay this out, directly and honest:
#

Let us lay this out, directly and honest:
Marjorie Taylor Greene’s decision to pass on this U.S. Senate race made our campaign much more difficult, and much more expensive.
Because the truth is, if Marjorie Taylor Greene was the Republican nominee, a lot of right-wing outside spending organizations would have spent their money elsewhere. The same thing happened last cycle when Kari Lake became the Republican nominee in Arizona.
Don’t get us wrong – the potential Republican candidates in Georgia are just as wildly MAGA as MTG – most people just don’t know them yet.
It’s going to take a lot of resources for us to break through the noise of right-wing spending and make sure voters across the state know who our opponents *really* are.

| | Peter, it’s Austin Davis. Recently, I had the honor of delivering several commencement speeches at some of the incredible universities and colleges across the Commonwealth. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/107742900/545682397/15868926?amount=10&source=SBD_AD_EM_FR_051425_COMMENCEMENT_90DO30MO_D1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NzIyMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzYWVjYjEwMy05ZTMxLWYwMTEtYTVmMS02MDQ1YmRhOWQ5NmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=I8wG5GHCB8kfPD4m9q6dQMjfSJpuA-SqRZBFO7stF4c=) **This is an especially impactful moment for me personally, because I’m actually a first-generation college graduate. ** I’ll never forget walking across the stage to receive my diploma at my college graduation and thinking how far I’d come. I felt such gratitude for my parents and my community. I got to feel those same feelings again while delivering these commencement addresses. While I am blessed with this awesome responsibility to represent Pennsylvania as Lieutenant Governor, I know it is not one that I alone have paid for. It was paid for by the blood, sweat and tears of those who came before me. I work to honor that every day. **I don’t think in my grandparents’ wildest dreams they would have ever imagined that their grandson would one day occupy the second highest office in Pennsylvania.** It’s this understanding that motivates me to make life better for everyone who will come after me. For my daughter, Harper, and for your kids and grandkids. When I reflect on my gratitude to my grandparents and parents, it spurs me to do better for our future. That’s why I care so much about investing in our shared future. [**I want to continue fighting for Pennsylvania. I know we can do better for each other and the generations that will come after us by fighting injustice, wherever and whenever we see it. # Hi friends,
#
It has been a busy couple of months for our team! We kicked off our federal oversight town halls in Eugene last month, followed by Portland, and just a few weeks ago, we hosted an event in Bend. We've heard from so many of you about how federal actions have impacted your daily lives. We are using that information as we look at the legal steps we can take to protect Oregonians.

The more they print, the less your money is worth. And now, with **[$1 trillion deficits every quarter,](http://trk.thedcbugle.com/?xtl=t01w64adwhjdebh3q8i7qwjsku2qmvyphm5tvsio6rx3qfi3hlc3kuur3jchvst0c550gcuqo62s5gvlthja4d0r96ymsjemqjo1y2tsrdf0lq6mrj0xwqitkho0rzhapatwgmtgqankhc6k7nxaeuz0w9drvgt5l1j9lybh3woj2fd298jslfwql42bzg1tj4s56qtw0tq81o34vyrs7sixvwx4gow5f5kjhe3areo8u2wv7p5slf33owrvyc6mwjdxi1w2za57jo&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=swb6li&__onlt=h)** we're locked in a loop: More borrowing → Higher interest → Bigger deficits → Repeat. As foreign buyers walk away from U.S. debt, the **Federal Reserve steps in,** quietly fueling inflation and undermining every dollar you've saved. **[The fallout is already here. The national debt is exploding. The interest payments are devouring the budget.](http://trk.thedcbugle.com/?xtl=t01w64adwhjdebh3q8i7qwjsku2qmvypho8jjtct00bdj606fs84z4axu5lmyg2wtzsqotdzo6tlg7wux7m59qh699wruuo8372gd69jbl767lq0163niru59q2l6uopm4bz4bh4iuau9kbdwg8xrfmdesxfoeiani98fbvh042uxn4c67o5tjbs4b962d0ggnf0kg86uuke3bkkzcg718s45z7nfjgtypejgq5s6vitvkz3ng75hgqtias4x2u8ysoflwfnm7ropf&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=swb6li&__onlt=h)** **The Consequences?** **Economic warfare,** plain and simple. And your traditional IRA or 401(k)? **Directly in the crosshairs.** A price tag every American will feel. It's no longer a warning - it's reality. Government spending may create a short-term GDP "bump" and it may look fine on paper - but don't be fooled. This is **not real growth.** It's artificial. Temporary. A mirage. **You can't control Washington. You can't stop inflation. As foreign buyers walk away from U.S. debt, the Federal Reserve steps in, quietly fueling inflation and undermining every dollar you've saved. The Consequences? Economic warfare, plain and simple. And your traditional IRA or 401(k)? Directly in the crosshairs. A price tag every American will feel. It's no longer a warning - it's reality. Government spending may create a short-term GDP "bump" and it may look fine on paper - but don't be fooled. This is not real growth. It's artificial. Temporary. A mirage. You can't control Washington. You can't stop inflation. But you can protect your retirement. subject: For the last 26 hours, I’ve been debating Trump’s agenda in Congress
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY KEVIN MULLIN FOR CONGRESS
body:
Republicans tried to strip healthcare from millions of Americans but we fought back through the night.

| | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/kevinmullinforcongress/big-news-i-was-just-appointed-to-the-house-energy-commerce-committee-9132961?e=292fde286a)

| Dear Peter,My Democratic colleauges and I just debated Donald Trump’s draconian budget cuts for over 26 hours in the House Energy & Commerce Committee. I’m tired and I’m angry. But losing sleep is nothing compared to losing healthcare.Under the direction of Donald Trump, House Republicans want to cut almost $1 trillion from Medicaid, resulting in 13.7 million Americans losing their healthcare. This is a generational fight to protect the future of Medicaid and I’m ready to keep fighting.
---

| In total, Democrats offered 33 amendments that would have helped everyday Americans. But my GOP colleagues blocked all of them - doubling down on a budget that will leave Americans sicker, hungrier, and poorer.Congressional Republicans won their majorities last year by promising to reduce the cost of living. Instead, they’re making it harder for working families, sick children, and special needs individuals to access the critical care they need. All while the price of groceries, gas, and everyday goods continues to rise.But House Democrats won't sit idle while Republicans attempt to bankrupt Medicaid in the middle of the night. We won't sit idle while hard working Americans struggle to afford basic needs. We won't sit idle while unelected billionaires like Elon Musk raid federal tax dollars to benefit his corrupt schemes.
---

| | | | | | | | | | | Every week when I fly to DC - I’m fighting against Trump’s corrupt, anti-democratic agenda. | | | | [](https://nicolemalliotakis.emlnk9.com/lt.php?x=3DZy~GE6J3ea5HV._g5GWOdw16IkudAkj~ZkYnfEKaHOEKBAyEy.0OFs2nJziNLwj_YwbHLFIXWf)

| | | Hi Friend-
I have big news to report.
My colleagues and I on the House Ways and Means Committee **passed the extension and expansion of the Trump Tax Cut.** Now, our One Big Beautiful Bill must be passed by the full House and the Senate before it can be signed by President Trump.
**[As a member of the House Ways and Means Committee, I am proud that this legislation includes 8 Key Priorities that I fought for during negotiations:](https://nicolemalliotakis.emlnk9.com/lt.php?x=3DZy~GE6J3ea5HV._g5GWOdw16IkudAkj~ZkYnfEKaHOEKBAyEy.0OFs2nJziNLwj_YwbHLFIXWh)**
---
| | | **1\. Bonus Senior Tax Deduction** Providing an additional deduction for seniors age 65 and over with incomes up to $150,000 per couple.
---
| | |
---
| | | **2\. Expanded Child Tax Credit**
Increasing the credit to $2,500.
---
| | |
---
| | | **3\. Increased SALT Deduction** Raising the cap on the State and Local Tax Deduction from $10,000 to $30,000.
---
| | |
---
| | | **4\. No Tax on Auto Interest** Making auto loan interest on American-made cars fully tax deductible.
---
| | |
---
| | | **5\. No Alternative Minimum Tax**

---
| | |
---
| | | **6\. Employer Participation in Repayment Act** Extending the ability of employers to provide up to $5,250 annually tax free for students loan repayments.
---
| | |
---
| | | **7\. Educational Choice for Children Act** Creating a tax credit for charitable contributions to organizations offering scholarships for K-12 students in public or private schools.
---
| | |
---
| | | **8\. Higher Standard Deduction** Increasing the standard deduction to $16,300 for individuals and $36,600 for families.
---
| | |
---

[](https://substack.com/redirect/ff8dc888-b309-44f8-8ad7-d9641c5a1470?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
I am thrilled and humbled to (_finally_) announce my next project.
I am joining Project Zero as an _Climate and Ocean Science Advisor_ and [ambassador.](https://substack.com/redirect/14636acb-daf6-444d-989c-c3c6a72115a0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
In this role, among other things, I will travel the world to document and share how climate change has impacted the ocean and especially coral reefs and the people, plants and animals that depend upon them for them.
From Kenya to Socotra, I'm meeting with the scientists and communities witnessing climate change first-hand.
Through[ Project Zero](https://substack.com/redirect/cea9dccd-e4f4-4701-ad09-f939be926858?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)'s [Coral Collective](https://substack.com/redirect/d9bc8370-1656-43ec-a885-5c896a380c5c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), the upcoming launch of the Academy for Coral will work within the United Nations' framework in advancing the G20's commitment to address climate change and SDG 14, Life Below Water.
My role will be to help build this education resource and serve as the guide to the work to save coral reefs, to bring the public cutting-edge science and the voices from communities utilizing them.
When I join the United Nations Ocean Conference in Nice, France next month, I'll be an ambassador for a program that is not only preventing coral loss, but also training the next generation of coral experts.
* * *
### _Thirty Six for Coral_
During UNOC next month, The Coral Collective will be hosting _**Thirty Six for Coral**_ , an exhibition of 36 celebrated artists who have come together to help protect and restore coral reefs. Thirty Six for Coral makes its debut alongside the highly anticipated third United Nations Ocean Conference, which takes place in Nice, France from June 9th to 13th, 2025.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/fc71ed43-6eb7-44af-9e2d-56456da0f0b3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
_Thirty Six for Coral_ is being exhibited at the iconic Grand Hotel du Cap-Ferrat in the South of France from June 12-20. This immersive exhibition brings together 36 celebrated artists whose stunning works will serve as a powerful call to action for global conservation efforts for coral reefs, the rainforests of the sea. We aim to raise global awareness and secure essential funding for protection and restoration of one of the most critically endangered ecosystems on Earth.
Pieces from Los Angeles-native artist [Retna](https://substack.com/redirect/24bbe0d1-d3e6-4a34-b9c0-380ce5742f35?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), British-artist [Helen Beard](https://substack.com/redirect/7ef603ff-c5a7-451a-a6c1-26c08e09d568?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and British-Italian artist [Petroc Sesti](https://substack.com/redirect/54876c0a-8c89-49f1-856e-ddee8a01a19b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) are live now.
Artwork available for bidding at forcoral.org
You can [begin bidding on the artwork now here](https://substack.com/redirect/6111936f-2dfd-43e0-9195-db0d8f2bc926?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and more artists and pieces will be added over the next several weeks.
If bidding on high-priced art isn't your thing, please share this post and[ links](https://substack.com/redirect/d9bc8370-1656-43ec-a885-5c896a380c5c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) with those who are!

* * *
### _Why I 'm joining Project Zero_
If there's one thing I know, it's the beach.
I know the feeling of the sand on my skin, and the salt water in my hair. I know the physics that drive the rhythm of the waves. I know what happens when powerful storms erase it.
I've spent my life studying storms, working to protect our communities from the rising waters.
I've fought to strengthen our science, and to strengthen our communities.
The oceans tell our stories - who we were, who we are, where we're going.
But the life force within these waters faces an unprecedented crisis.
I'm joining Project Zero to help train an army of scientists and reef rangers to monitor, protect and save our corals.
Without coral reefs, algae takes over, fishing industries collapse, our planet loses its main source of oxygen, and coastlines would lose an important barrier to storms.
Because when the coral dies, our ocean dies.
You can help Project Zero develop the science and tools by [donating today.](https://substack.com/redirect/cc474a53-b95e-4aeb-8470-caaffc8fe3d9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

While saving the world may seem like a larger-than-life endeavor, abstract and distant, you can help us save these small, critical pieces today.

Dear Peter, Did you know that our state legislature is considering passing a bill that will fund the killing of “predatory” animals by “Wildlife Services” with Predator Control Districts ([**HB 2403**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/107748720/545700347/-835341822?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjI5YzMyYTQ3LWE2MzEtZjAxMS1hNWYxLTYwNDViZGE5ZDk2YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=wgruIaqYR80X1PQ4pNv80xLA4UGX_5d7JXptsdgnIzU=&emci=6ffd1951-632c-f011-8b3d-6045bded8cca&emdi=29c32a47-a631-f011-a5f1-6045bda9d96b&ceid=2107230))? **Legislators need to hear from those who care about animals on why this bill is bad and needs to be stopped.**[**Will you send your message now?**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/107748721/545700348/-154566637?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjI5YzMyYTQ3LWE2MzEtZjAxMS1hNWYxLTYwNDViZGE5ZDk2YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=wgruIaqYR80X1PQ4pNv80xLA4UGX_5d7JXptsdgnIzU=&emci=6ffd1951-632c-f011-8b3d-6045bded8cca&emdi=29c32a47-a631-f011-a5f1-6045bda9d96b&ceid=2107230)

How would this bill work? It would allow formation of local “predator damage control districts” to collect money from property owners for spending on "predator control." These animals could range anywhere from bears, to coyotes, foxes, beavers, or other species. This money raised would then fund the federal “Wildlife Services” to kill Oregon’s wildlife that are deemed a threat to private property, without having to use or consider non-lethal methods. You’ve probably heard of the “Wildlife Services” program before: it’s known for its cruel and unnecessary killing of wildlife, in an untargeted way. In the most recent year in which data was collected in 2024, Wildlife Services killed more than 150,000 wild animals in Oregon using methods including neck and leg snares, steel-jawed leghold traps, shooting animals from helicopters and planes, and gassing coyote and fox dens. Don’t let our legislators approve giving Wildlife Services more funding and therefore more power to carry out more inhumane and unnecessary wildlife killings. Killing animals like black bears, foxes, mountain lions, beavers, and coyotes is not an effective way to reduce human-wildlife conflict, and may even make the problem worse by disrupting wildlife’s natural social structures. If you care about animals and Oregon’s precious wildlife, [**please take action to stop this dangerous bill before it’s too late**.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/107748723/545700350/-154566637?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjI5YzMyYTQ3LWE2MzEtZjAxMS1hNWYxLTYwNDViZGE5ZDk2YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=wgruIaqYR80X1PQ4pNv80xLA4UGX_5d7JXptsdgnIzU=&emci=6ffd1951-632c-f011-8b3d-6045bded8cca&emdi=29c32a47-a631-f011-a5f1-6045bda9d96b&ceid=2107230)

clean_body: Nothing grabs attention like fired up American patriots | | | | | Peter, I’m writing to you today because I believe you’re an America First Patriot who’s sick of the open borders madness. And that’s exactly who I’m hoping to reach with my Birthright Citizenship Survey. We’re launching a nationwide campaign to educate and activate American patriots on the real intention of Birthright Citizenship... ...and the real disaster it has become for American workers and American citizens. Despite what the mainstream media and too many low-level judges are saying, Birthright Citizenship for tourists and illegal aliens is not written into the Constitution.Rather, the 14th Amendment that contains Birthright Citizenship was enacted to grant full citizenship to the slaves freed by Abraham Lincoln — along with their children and their children’s children. It was not meant to apply to foreign visitors...And it was definitely not for illegal aliens.In fact, the text of the 14th Amendment clearly states that it only applies to “persons born or naturalized in the United States, AND subject to the jurisdiction thereof.” But over time, government bureaucrats stretched the 14th Amendment and automatically gave U.S. citizenship to every birth to illegal aliens, and even to foreign nationals vacationing in the United States.Now, the situation has gotten completely out of hand...In 2023 alone, there were roughly 350,000 births to illegal aliens in the U.S. Tourists gave birth to another 40,000. These so-called “anchor babies” can keep illegal alien parents from getting deported and give a legal basis for a whole chain of migrants to push their way into America.Is it any surprise that human traffickers and even high-end birth tourism companies are making billions of dollars?This is not by accident – it’s by design. In fact, the Obama State Department changed U.S. visa rules to explicitly allow women to travel to America for the purpose of giving birth in 2015!Thankfully, the Trump administration overturned this rule and pushed back on illegal immigration on a number of fronts.But Trump can’t do it alone. Fortunately, grassroots organizing is what NumbersUSA does best. Over the past thirty years, we’ve grown from a small staff into the largest single-issue advocacy group in the United States.Back in 1996, we pioneered the tactic of masses of grassroots voters faxing elected officials directly.In 2007, when Ted Kennedy (remember him?) was trying to grant amnesty to millions of illegal aliens, NumbersUSA mobilized citizens in such numbers that they shut down the Congressional switchboard. The New York Times “blamed” NumbersUSA as the key factor in blocking Kennedy’s decades-long mass amnesty dream.It was a real David-and-Goliath struggle, and we won.Fast forward to 2025, and our populist immigration position is gaining traction in Washington.The DC power brokers are now calling us when they need to mobilize America-First patriots across the country. To be clear, that’s not because they want to talk to me, Roy Beck.It’s because they know that NumbersUSA is the connection point for 8 million members who understand how our immigration system is utterly broken......and what it will take to fix it. We’ve never had a President like Donald Trump who gets this issue on such a visceral level.But it takes more than just one man to reverse this open borders insanity. And there’s no denying the impact when a mountain of responses pours in from across the country.It proves that the immigration action we’re calling for isn’t just coming from me and the great folks at NumbersUSA—no, it’s the unmistakable DEMAND of the American people.And at that point, a politician doesn’t need one ounce of courage.Just a pinch of common sense will be enough to realize that voting against the American people is a “one-way ticket to Palookaville.”That’s how you take a nationwide network of Patriots and turn it into victories at the ballot box, in Congress, and for generations of Americans to come.That’s what NumbersUSA is all about. **Here 's a picture of my wife and me at the new member orientation in Washington. **

[](http://links.harriganfornc.com/u/click?_t=687026f8d8f7415aa539c5385c376b1f&_m=56a7e5f296c344fb9bfba51bd7abc3e7&_e=gjAyrLQuDAcOUpmdznfqiNVXm35a7_u_Sx12YV6v8J8RuIEJQESm5TJXC8qXVJkJHud8htinmIqtxobjkvH2E9NiYcoyPzF4tEI2gPTf7MZ8Ew9AlFD71vd1vj7Y4FusvkUPDXM0p2YGn2W1Lv97WymYWieLiyyBCJ6A-HRogiezSJGeyv0a7KwLkD1vAUSzTeJ4iva0mBfVpY5nl3v_eD_nfU3KxuZHMmnslciVUFzxtrM1E1BdaDEd6-aKYw94jE5GfdoAeVr43p-OXBCuL3RFc806j5B2nxhCGPAM0ovmTZdD7DtMRG8JPFF-RKZsRTaUjGKYWYYT_solxTmRDDHnbF20YAPrgWVxwIv7YpQJSfgSxY7g6LBuyRF94onO0LqH_D9xCsTmqhvY-cspj6Cb9T4fwyan9u5pd1NKSI9w0aADxtWgttQpFmJGmpQKEhtrDWuUbhCWo8lV7EdiQ84dNlChdlNn4yVpTsfRfx9qy6RsEDVEgdaiePNoH6dHkokFLJlNVTcyUPYM49mtSIyW9OMZ9KokHE1g3KG4HCo%3D)
Most important of all, I'm the dad of two beautiful girls. I'm honored to have just won my race for North Carolina's 10th Congressional District, and I'm ready to work alongside President Trump to make our nation great again. **Here 's a pic of the whole family in D.C. when I had the honor of being sworn into office.****
**
Cleaning up the mess Joe and Kamala left us won 't be easy, but it's a challenge I'm eager to take on. With President Trump in the Oval Office and House and Senate Majorities in Congress, we're more equipped than ever to get our country back on track. The only thing we're missing is the resources to keep going.

body:

Peter,

I came to Congress to solve real problems for the people of CA-27, and despite the dysfunction coming out of the Trump administration, I’m focused on delivering meaningful results.

That’s why I just launched the Build America Caucus -- a new bipartisan group I created to cut through gridlock and focus on tangible progress in housing, infrastructure, health care and energy.

Here are just a few ‘gridlock facts’ that folks are always surprised to hear:

- It costs four times more to build affordable housing in California than market-rate housing in Texas -- and takes nearly two years longer.

- One in four infrastructure projects gets stuck in permitting paperwork for over six years before construction even begins.

- The cost of building a mile of highway has tripled in the last 50 years -- even after adjusting for inflation.

- Researchers spend nearly half their time on compliance paperwork, not innovation.

The list goes on, and the inefficiencies are literally too numerous for this email. Bureaucratic red tape is holding up the important work of rebuilding our communities. Costs are rising, and projects are delayed for years on end -- leaving our existing infrastructure to crumble.

From wildfire risk, to broadband access, to repairing highways, I won’t stand by and keep these issues on the back burner. And with your support, I’m fulfilling my promise to CA-27 and fighting for what our communities need.

More to come,

George

body:
| Donald Trump wants to rule a dictatorship — not lead a government of the people, by the people, and for the people.
# [](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/61?t=1&akid=8584%2E5257348%2ERRkuCm)
Derek,
Donald Trump was recently asked on Meet the Press whether he needed to uphold the Constitution as President of the United States.
His answer may surprise you — honestly, it may not — but here’s what he said:
**_“I don’t know.”_**
**Derek, the President of the United States said that he does not know whether it’s his duty to uphold the Constitution.**
We all know that Trump holds very little regard for the rule of law — but his answer was shocking considering that just a few months ago, he took his oath of office and swore to preserve, protect, and defend the Constitution. For the second time.
**Clearly, his oath of office means very little to him.**
At every turn, Donald Trump has shown a blatant disregard for the rule of law, the Constitution, our national security, and the needs of the American people.
He’s leading the most corrupt administration imaginable. He’s weaponizing the Department of Justice and attacking judges for not giving him the green light to have unchecked power. And he’s surrounded himself with extremist loyalists who are helping him subvert the rule of law, like FBI Director Kash Patel and Attorney General Pam Bondi.
Trump is undermining our Constitution, eroding our institutions, threatening our democratic way of life, and attacking our most basic rights like due process.
In that very same interview, Trump was asked whether he would uphold the Fifth Amendment, which guarantees that no person shall be deprived of life, liberty, or property without due process of the law.
**He not only refused to say that he would protect the Fifth Amendment but also complained that the right to due process would cause delays in the courts and make it harder for him to deport people without a court hearing.**
Yes, people have a right to appear before they’re deported to a maximum security prison in El Salvador so the courts can determine whether the person can be legally deported or if the government even has the right person. None of which is a given with this administration.
It might be cumbersome, but it’s necessary. The Constitution wasn’t written to maximize deportations, Derek. **It was written to maximize our freedom.**
Without checks and balances and due process, what we’d have is a dictatorship, not a government of the people, by the people, and for the people.
[**Donald Trump may not know that it’s his job to uphold the Constitution and defend due process, but I do. That’s why I’m going to continue fighting back against him to protect our democracy and the rule of law. If you support this work, will you pitch in before tonight’s mid-month fundraising deadline?**](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=q22025_abs_em.gs9A_9&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_MMG_AC90_20250515_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=4&akid=8584%2E5257348%2ERRkuCm)

He’s targeting the vulnerable and the brave — one group at a time. **This is what fascism looks like in the 21st century: not in grainy black-and-white footage, but in press releases, subpoenas, and sham investigations.** And while Trump uses the Justice Department as his personal hit squad, his billionaire allies are busy bankrolling the takeover — one state at a time. Now he’s selling “Trump 2028: Rewrite the Rules” merch — because in his mind, elections are already decided, rules are for suckers, and democracy is an inconvenience to be discarded. We’ve seen this movie before. It ends in silence, exile, prison, and worse — unless we stop it. **Trump’s biggest backer? A billionaire with multiple Nazi controversies under his belt. That’s no accident. That’s the company he keeps — because that’s the future he wants.** But here’s the thing: **we are NOT afraid. And we will NOT back down.

subject: Senator Alsobrooks Newsletter -- May 15
body:
|

Dear friends and neighbors,
First, I want to thank the hundreds of Marylanders who turned out to the National Institutes of Health this past weekend to make their voices heard and ensure the Trump Administration and Secretary Kennedy know we are **Sick of It**. We are sick of RFK Jr.'s dangerous anti-vaccine beliefs, as he has perpetuated the spread of the largest measles outbreak in over two decades, an outbreak that is killing children. We are sick of him spreading dangerous misinformation not rooted in scientific fact, such as his claims that low levels of fluoride in drinking water are dangerous, and that Blacks should have a different vaccine schedule. We are sick of him threatening some of our most vulnerable, calling for a registry for people with autism, and using disparaging language for those with disabilities. We are sick of him degrading scientists and doctors, when he is neither. He has decimated HHS, and his actions will cost countless lives. I believe that we can expect to see Americans suffer from funding cuts for cancer research, cuts to prevent the spread of disease, cuts to research health disparities, cuts for violence prevention among children, and cuts to programs that ensure the efficacy of preventative HIV medications. On Wednesday during a Health, Education, Labor, and Pensions committee hearing, I confronted Secretary Kennedy about cuts he made to key programs, the scientists he fired, and the fact that he was unable to answer questions about divisions within his agency. Click [here](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenAlsobrooks&crop=14412.8259194.5343978.7190525&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.msnbc.com%2fthe-last-word%2fwatch%2fdem-senator-alsobrooks-explains-to-rfk-jr-his-own-aunt-s-legacy-during-senate-hearing-239602757615&redir_log=84193764187937) to see Lawrence O'Donnell's recap of the hearing, and check out this [Baltimore Banner](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenAlsobrooks&crop=14412.8259194.5343978.7190525&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.thebaltimorebanner.com%2fpolitics-power%2fnational-politics%2fangela-alsobrooks-rfk-kennedy-3QX3SJX7PBBRTKLETVSA72PGDY%2f&redir_log=600083772028835) article for a readout. The bottom line is RFK Jr. is not only unqualified for the job but he also presents a clear and present threat to the American people. And because of his dangerous and callous actions, and in defense of our families and children, on Monday, I introduced a Senate Resolution calling on Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. to resign or be fired as Health and Human Services Secretary. I am going to fight to gain support for this resolution, because our families deserve better, our children deserve better, the American people deserve better. **Sick of It Round Up** Here are some of the headlines from the weekend event: **WUSA 9** [NIH 'Sick of It' rally gains traction with Sen. Alsobrooks taking the stand against RFK Jr.'s federal workforce cuts](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenAlsobrooks&crop=14412.8259194.5343978.7190525&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.wusa9.com%2fvideo%2fnews%2fpolitics%2ffederal-fallout%2fnih-sick-of-it-rally-gains-traction-with-sen-alsobrooks-taking-the-stand-against-rfk-jrs-federal-workforce-cuts%2f65-1ec0bd68-f836-4008-8664-9414af27cbda&redir_log=31314522151377) **Baltimore Sun**['No confidence': Alsobrooks to call for RFK Jr. to resign](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenAlsobrooks&crop=14412.8259194.5343978.7190525&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.baltimoresun.com%2f%3fp%3d11437328&redir_log=284289719335254) **Sky News Australia**[ Protesters rally against cuts to health care and research and call for RFK Jr to resign](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenAlsobrooks&crop=14412.8259194.5343978.7190525&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.skynews.com.au%2fworld-news%2funited-states%2fprotesters-rally-against-cuts-to-health-care-and-research-and-call-for-rfk-jr-to-resign%2fvideo%2f45594646322cb8e04f3a74484b85965d&redir_log=683161345871163) **The Gazette** [Alsobrooks calls for RFK Jr. to resign as HHS secretary](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenAlsobrooks&crop=14412.8259194.5343978.7190525&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fgazette.com%2fnews%2fwex%2falsobrooks-calls-for-rfk-jr-to-resign-as-hhs-secretary%2farticle_84b0323c-ed2a-5f97-a3e3-3f18cc81c5f8.html&redir_log=387298386978868) **AFRO American Newspapers** [Sen. Alsobrooks calls on RFK to resign](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenAlsobrooks&crop=14412.8259194.5343978.7190525&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fafro.com%2fmaryland-leaders-alsobrooks-event&redir_log=63459004831357) **Transparency: Fighting Trump 's Budget Request** HHS isn't the only area experiencing detrimental cuts that will adversely impact the American people. President Trump's budget request is one that's dangerous to all of us, and seeks to cut critical programs like Medicare and Medicaid, Title I and K-12 funding, funding to prevent the outbreak of diseases, and funding for low income families to afford the astronomical costs of housing, to name a few. This is nothing more than the President working to give trillions of dollars in tax breaks to his wealthy friends, while pulling the rug out from under our families - those vulnerable, working two jobs and still struggling to feed their families, and struggling with a life threatening illness and hoping federally funded research finds a cure. President Trump's budget request can be found [here,](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenAlsobrooks&crop=14412.8259194.5343978.7190525&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.whitehouse.gov%2fomb%2finformation-resources%2fbudget%2fthe-presidents-fy-2026-discretionary-budget-request%2f&redir_log=085882901611783) but I want to pull out some highlights for full transparency. Among the cuts that Marylanders and Americans can expect: • Elimination of the Low-Income Housing Energy Assistance Program (LIHEAP) that helps so many pay energy bills. • $18 billion in cuts to the National Institutes of Health, severely hampering research and development that lead to breakthroughs in Alzheimer's, cancer, cardiovascular disease. HIV/AIDS and so many more. • Elimination of programs that support disease prevention at the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention with a staggering $3.5 billion funding cut. • In the midst of the opioid pandemic, Trump wants to cut over $1 billion from the Substance Abuse and Mental Health Service Administration. • $674 million cuts to the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid. • $4.5 billion cuts to Title I and K-12 by reducing Department of Education staff. • $3.3 billion in cuts to Community Development Block Grant (CDBG) funding which helps local governments pursue affordable housing and neighborhood revitalization. • Eliminates the EPA's entire Environmental Justice Program. • Guts U.S. diplomacy and global engagement with an 83 percent cut to the State Department and International Affairs budget. This includes a drastic reduction in foreign aid, slashing over $20 billion from programs that support global health, humanitarian relief, and democracy promotion. • Cuts $1.5 billion from the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration, which is tasked with monitoring, predicting, and forecasting the weather and climate. • Cuts $391 million from the U.S. Forest Service's Operating Budget. • Nearly $1 billion in cuts to Bureau of Indian Affairs (BIA) programs that support tribal operations. And these represent just _**SOME**_ of the cuts this President and his Administration are looking to make on the backs of the American people. I just want to be sure you know what's on the chopping block and what the President's marching orders are to my colleagues on the other side of the aisle. And just to be sure I'm clear. I support a more efficient government. I support cutting wasteful spending. But that's not what this Administration is doing. They're cutting critical spending to support tax breaks for billionaires. I will use every legislative tool at my disposal to push back against these harmful cuts, and I hope you'll use your voice to stand with me. **Fighting in a Bipartisan Way** As I told you from the beginning. I am willing to work with any colleague who is interested in working in the best interest of the American people. I was proud to introduce the bipartisan Homeless Children and Youth Act (HCYA) alongside Alabama Senator Katie Britt. This bipartisan legislation would support the 4.2 million youth and young adults experiencing homelessness each year in the United States and ensure that all individuals experiencing homelessness are given the support they need to exit homelessness for good. HCYA expands the definition of homelessness to ensure children and youth are eligible for services to help them exit homelessness. It also requires annual data to be collected and published on homeless children, youth, and families and ensures communities can direct funding in an effective way to prevent and end homelessness. It is critical we pass this legislation to ensure all children experiencing homelessness can get the support they need to exit homelessness for good. HYCA will begin to close the barrier to services for many young families and is a true action to one of my guiding principles: 'love your neighbor as yourself.' This legislation is an important step in ending homelessness in our communities and breaking generational cycles. Click [here](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenAlsobrooks&crop=14412.8259194.5343978.7190525&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.foxnews.com%2fpolitics%2fdems-gop-form-rare-alliance-youth-homelessness-bill-crisis-impacts-nation&redir_log=160102774221751) to read the Fox News article on our new bill. I also introduced the Highway Funding Transferability Improvement Act with North Dakota Senator Kevin Cramer. This bipartisan legislation would raise the cap of transfers within Departments of Transportation (DOT) from 50% annually to 75%, giving state DOTs more flexibility to direct funds to high-priority infrastructure projects in their states. The enhanced transferability allows state DOTs, including MDOT, to make investments better reflecting local needs and deliver results for constituents. I look forward to working with Senator Cramer in our capacities as Chairman and Ranking Member of the EPW Subcommittee on Transportation and Infrastructure to get this legislation signed into law. **Fighting Through Legislation** I joined Senator Jeff Merkley (D-Ore.) and Senate Democratic Leader Chuck Schumer (D-N.Y.) in introducing a brand-new effort to crack down on cryptocurrency-related corruption by elected officials at the highest levels of the federal government. It's critical that Congress passes crypto legislation that provides a regulatory framework, spurs innovation, and keeps that innovation in America. I am working on a bipartisan basis with my co-leads, Senators Hagerty, Scott, Lummis, and Gillibrand to do just that. This emerging market needs to remain fair and competitive for every American. That's why I'm proud to introduce this resolution alongside Senator Merkley and Leader Schumer. It's as preposterous as it is so woefully predictable that this President is trying to organize yet another scam to sell influence and enrich himself. We know it's wrong. We need to make it illegal. Read the full text of the End Crypto Corruption Act [here](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenAlsobrooks&crop=14412.8259194.5343978.7190525&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.merkley.senate.gov%2fwp-content%2fuploads%2fEnd-Crypto-Corruption-Act.pdf&redir_log=397954376725552). **Other Legislation I Have Cosponsored** _A Resolution condemning any acceptance of Presidential aircraft, or any other substantial gift, from a foreign government._ • The resolution states that President Trump's acceptance of a luxury 747 from Qatar would violate the Foreign Emoluments Clause of the Constitution and poses counter-intelligence and national security concerns. • It condemns the acceptance of the aircraft from a foreign government and demands that such a gift be only accepted with the explicit consent of Congress, in accordance with the law. _The Making It Likely for Families of the Military to Live with Leave Access (MIL FMLA) Act _ • This bill would close gaps in the Family Medical Leave Act by adding reserve components and domestic deployments as covered active duty for family members; eliminating the requirement that military caregiver protections only apply to veterans who served within the last five years; allowing military caregivers to utilize special military caregiver FMLA leave more than once; expanding military caregiver provisions to cover domestic partners and other close family members like aunts, uncles, nephews, nieces, grandparents, grandchildren, and other loved ones; and creating a new form of leave, specifically for veterans who need extended time to address serious injuries or illnesses related to their service. _The Respect, Advancement, and Increasing Support for Educators (RAISE) Act of 2025_ • This bill amends the Internal Revenue Code to provide a refundable tax credit of up to $15,000 for eligible elementary, secondary, and early childhood educators, with higher amounts targeted toward teachers in high-poverty schools. The bill also increases and expands the existing educator expense deduction and ensures that this federal benefit supplements, rather than replaces, state and local compensation. • Additionally, it guarantees mandatory funding for local educational agencies that maintain or increase teacher salaries and authorizes federal grants to support teacher recruitment, retention, and professional development. _The Keep Americans Safe Act_ •This bill would ban the sale or transfer of high-capacity gun magazines capable of holding more than 10 rounds to anyone other than law enforcement; ban the possession of a high-capacity gun magazine manufactured after the date of enactment by anyone other than law enforcement; authorize high-capacity magazine buyback programs; and give law enforcement agencies additional tools. _The Background Check Expansion Act _ •The bill would require background checks for the sale or transfer of all firearms with very limited but practical exceptions. This requirement extends to all unlicensed sellers, whether they do business online, at gun shows, or out of their home. **Release Our Education Funding** I led Maryland lawmakers in demanding the Trump Administration release $98 million promised for education funding, to the state of Maryland. We also urged Secretary of Education Linda McMahon to work with us to ensure we get the critical funding that our children and educators need and were promised. Secretary McMahon said she wants to 'return education to the states where it belongs.' We believe that approving Maryland's application for late liquidation of relief funds would do just that. The Maryland delegation stands ready to partner with the Department in ensuring the disbursement of this key funding to Maryland. You can read the full letter to Secretary McMahon [here](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenAlsobrooks&crop=14412.8259194.5343978.7190525&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.alsobrooks.senate.gov%2fwp-content%2fuploads%2f2025%2f05%2f25.5.2-ESSER-MD-FINAL.pdf&redir_log=743445435366538). **Howard University School of Law** It was my great honor to serve as commencement speaker for Howard University School of Law's 2025 Hooding Ceremony. I am so hopeful for the future and for the legal profession as these young leaders set out to change the world. I told the graduates the future is not something to fear, and the state of our world should spark something in all of us. But it's their responsibility to keep that fire alive. I also shared _The Cold Within_ by James Patrick Kenny, a poem I think offers a healthy cautionary take for all of us right now. A reminder to remember our humanity and how we go farther together. Watch [here](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenAlsobrooks&crop=14412.8259194.5343978.7190525&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fx.com%2fSen_Alsobrooks%2fstatus%2f1922404965735121299&redir_log=189885799185333). **Stay Informed** I know these are difficult times. But please know that I will continue fighting for you every step of the way. We will not give up. We will not give in to this Administration, and I ask that you continue to fight alongside us. Please continue to reach out to us. You can call the office, connect with us, or find resources for those who have recently been laid off at [alsobrooks.senate.gov](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenAlsobrooks&crop=14412.8259194.5343978.7190525&report_id=&redirect=http%3a%2f%2falsobrooks.senate.gov&redir_log=983830187668200). You can also follow us on Bluesky, Instagram, Facebook, Threads, YouTube, and X. We are in this TOGETHER. Sincerely, Angela D. Alsobrooks
United States Senator
[Click here to Unsubscribe.](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/EForm.aspx?__cid=SenAlsobrooks&__fid=100022&__crop=14412.8259194.5343978.7190525)

Fighting in a Bipartisan Way As I told you from the beginning. I am willing to work with any colleague who is interested in working in the best interest of the American people. I was proud to introduce the bipartisan Homeless Children and Youth Act (HCYA) alongside Alabama Senator Katie Britt. This bipartisan legislation would support the 4.2 million youth and young adults experiencing homelessness each year in the United States and ensure that all individuals experiencing homelessness are given the support they need to exit homelessness for good. HCYA expands the definition of homelessness to ensure children and youth are eligible for services to help them exit homelessness. It also requires annual data to be collected and published on homeless children, youth, and families and ensures communities can direct funding in an effective way to prevent and end homelessness. It is critical we pass this legislation to ensure all children experiencing homelessness can get the support they need to exit homelessness for good. HYCA will begin to close the barrier to services for many young families and is a true action to one of my guiding principles: 'love your neighbor as yourself.' This legislation is an important step in ending homelessness in our communities and breaking generational cycles. Click to read the Fox News article on our new bill. I also introduced the Highway Funding Transferability Improvement Act with North Dakota Senator Kevin Cramer. This bipartisan legislation would raise the cap of transfers within Departments of Transportation (DOT) from 50% annually to 75%, giving state DOTs more flexibility to direct funds to high-priority infrastructure projects in their states. The enhanced transferability allows state DOTs, including MDOT, to make investments better reflecting local needs and deliver results for constituents. I look forward to working with Senator Cramer in our capacities as Chairman and Ranking Member of the EPW Subcommittee on Transportation and Infrastructure to get this legislation signed into law. Fighting Through Legislation I joined Senator Jeff Merkley (D-Ore.) and Senate Democratic Leader Chuck Schumer (D-N.Y.) in introducing a brand-new effort to crack down on cryptocurrency-related corruption by elected officials at the highest levels of the federal government. It's critical that Congress passes crypto legislation that provides a regulatory framework, spurs innovation, and keeps that innovation in America. I am working on a bipartisan basis with my co-leads, Senators Hagerty, Scott, Lummis, and Gillibrand to do just that. This emerging market needs to remain fair and competitive for every American. That's why I'm proud to introduce this resolution alongside Senator Merkley and Leader Schumer. It's as preposterous as it is so woefully predictable that this President is trying to organize yet another scam to sell influence and enrich himself. We know it's wrong. We need to make it illegal. Read the full text of the End Crypto Corruption Act . Other Legislation I Have Cosponsored A Resolution condemning any acceptance of Presidential aircraft, or any other substantial gift, from a foreign government. • The resolution states that President Trump's acceptance of a luxury 747 from Qatar would violate the Foreign Emoluments Clause of the Constitution and poses counter-intelligence and national security concerns. • It condemns the acceptance of the aircraft from a foreign government and demands that such a gift be only accepted with the explicit consent of Congress, in accordance with the law. The Making It Likely for Families of the Military to Live with Leave Access (MIL FMLA) Act • This bill would close gaps in the Family Medical Leave Act by adding reserve components and domestic deployments as covered active duty for family members; eliminating the requirement that military caregiver protections only apply to veterans who served within the last five years; allowing military caregivers to utilize special military caregiver FMLA leave more than once; expanding military caregiver provisions to cover domestic partners and other close family members like aunts, uncles, nephews, nieces, grandparents, grandchildren, and other loved ones; and creating a new form of leave, specifically for veterans who need extended time to address serious injuries or illnesses related to their service. The Respect, Advancement, and Increasing Support for Educators (RAISE) Act of 2025 • This bill amends the Internal Revenue Code to provide a refundable tax credit of up to $15,000 for eligible elementary, secondary, and early childhood educators, with higher amounts targeted toward teachers in high-poverty schools. The bill also increases and expands the existing educator expense deduction and ensures that this federal benefit supplements, rather than replaces, state and local compensation. • Additionally, it guarantees mandatory funding for local educational agencies that maintain or increase teacher salaries and authorizes federal grants to support teacher recruitment, retention, and professional development. The Keep Americans Safe Act •This bill would ban the sale or transfer of high-capacity gun magazines capable of holding more than 10 rounds to anyone other than law enforcement; ban the possession of a high-capacity gun magazine manufactured after the date of enactment by anyone other than law enforcement; authorize high-capacity magazine buyback programs; and give law enforcement agencies additional tools. The Background Check Expansion Act •The bill would require background checks for the sale or transfer of all firearms with very limited but practical exceptions. This requirement extends to all unlicensed sellers, whether they do business online, at gun shows, or out of their home. Release Our Education Funding I led Maryland lawmakers in demanding the Trump Administration release $98 million promised for education funding, to the state of Maryland. We also urged Secretary of Education Linda McMahon to work with us to ensure we get the critical funding that our children and educators need and were promised. Secretary McMahon said she wants to 'return education to the states where it belongs.' We believe that approving Maryland's application for late liquidation of relief funds would do just that. The Maryland delegation stands ready to partner with the Department in ensuring the disbursement of this key funding to Maryland. You can read the full letter to Secretary McMahon . Howard University School of Law It was my great honor to serve as commencement speaker for Howard University School of Law's 2025 Hooding Ceremony. I am so hopeful for the future and for the legal profession as these young leaders set out to change the world. I told the graduates the future is not something to fear, and the state of our world should spark something in all of us. But it's their responsibility to keep that fire alive. I also shared The Cold Within by James Patrick Kenny, a poem I think offers a healthy cautionary take for all of us right now. A reminder to remember our humanity and how we go farther together. Watch . Stay Informed I know these are difficult times. But please know that I will continue fighting for you every step of the way. We will not give up. We will not give in to this Administration, and I ask that you continue to fight alongside us. Please continue to reach out to us. You can call the office, connect with us, or find resources for those who have recently been laid off at . You can also follow us on Bluesky, Instagram, Facebook, Threads, YouTube, and X. We are in this TOGETHER. Sincerely, Angela D. Alsobrooks United States Senator

Peter, we’ve got some big news to share:
**Leaders We Deserve just announced our first endorsement of the 2026 cycle: State Sen. Robert Peters in the race for Illinois’ 2nd Congressional District.**
_“We need more Democrats who are willing to fight like hell for their communities — and that’s exactly what I’ll do when I’m in Congress. I’m honored to be able to partner with Leaders We Deserve as we work to get there.”_
– State Senator Robert Peters, Candidate for IL-2

The Trump administration plans to order Congress to end nearly **_all_** federal funding for public media — including NPR and PBS.

_This is censorship, and we have to raise our voices before it’s too late._

[**_25,000 signatures needed by midnight: Sign on now to show Trump that the American people want to protect free and accessible broadcasting >>_**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/107761280/545740099/436175811?refcode=LOC_EM_PET_2025.05.15_Public-Broadcasting_B1_F1_S1_C1_45AC-NS_RS-T0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTkvMS83MjcyMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyYmZkMzEzZi1iOTMxLWYwMTEtYTVmMS02MDQ1YmRhOWQ5NmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=G91FYmYdfADvuBNJlucyJCR-jTxsaHr1onQJaktUhGM=&emci=2552c615-b231-f011-a5f1-6045bda9d96b&emdi=2bfd313f-b931-f011-a5f1-6045bda9d96b&ceid=7659029) | | [SIGN THE PETITION >>](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/107761281/545740122/436175811?refcode=LOC_EM_PET_2025.05.15_Public-Broadcasting_B1_F1_S1_C1_45AC-NS_RS-T0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTkvMS83MjcyMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyYmZkMzEzZi1iOTMxLWYwMTEtYTVmMS02MDQ1YmRhOWQ5NmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=G91FYmYdfADvuBNJlucyJCR-jTxsaHr1onQJaktUhGM=&emci=2552c615-b231-f011-a5f1-6045bda9d96b&emdi=2bfd313f-b931-f011-a5f1-6045bda9d96b&ceid=7659029)

The Trump administration is expected to instruct Congress to cut $1.1 billion — or two years’ worth of funding — from the nonprofit organization that supports NPR and PBS.

Right now, we need to make our voices heard and show support for public broadcasting.

NPR and PBS are not the only targets of Republicans’ pursuit against “woke media”. Free educational kids' programming, emergency alerts _and_ public safety information are all at risk of being cut.

_Congress hasn’t acted yet, so we still have time to gather public support to stop this direct attack against free and public media._

subject: House votes to INCREASE harmful tailpipe emissions. We need your help before the Senate votes.
body:
To view this mail in a browser, copy https://links.messages.lcv.org/servlet/MailView?ms=MTI0OTg3NTgS1&r=NjA3MDU0MTAzNTc3S0&j=MjIyMDE5OTQ2MQS2&mt=1&rt=0 into your browser.
🚨 Republicans in Congress have launched an illegitimate bid to overturn California’s limits on tailpipe emissions, threatening clean air nationwide. Renew now to help us raise $30,000 by May 31 to stop this attack on our climate and health. $5 is all is takes >> https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/G8bxcKEVvqM~ The House of Representatives just voted to illegally overturn California’s
ability to limit vehicle tailpipe emissions, the leading source of greenhouse
gas emissions in the U.S. and a major contributor to diseases like cancer and
asthma. This is about much more than California. This is a broad attack on states’
rights and will lead to dirtier air, higher CO2 emissions, and worsening public
health across the country. Now, Republicans are considering breaking Senate rules to vote on the
illegitimate proposal. Our movement needs to respond to this latest attack on the air that we breathe
and the rights of states to set their own environmental safeguards. Please, help us raise $30,000 by the end of this month by renewing your LCV membership for just $5 today to help us push back >> https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/~NwYf49G~ RENEW YOUR MEMBERSHIP FOR $5 >> https://links.messages.lcv. The reach of this illegitimate scheme goes far beyond the borders of California.
If Republicans succeed, this move will limit all consumers’ choices for cleaner
vehicles and increase health-harming tailpipe pollution. Here’s how: 👉 California’s tailpipe pollution limits require cleaner cars than the federal
standards, and those cars are cheaper to own and operate than comparable
gasoline-only cars. 👉 With around 39 million people and roughly 396,000 miles of public roadways in California,all the major car manufacturers have worked to meet the standard California
sets, boosting the options for cleaner and more efficient vehicles for all
consumers. 👉 Meanwhile, the Trump administration has said it is going to gut the federal rules, allowing
dirtier vehicles to dominate.Bottom line, if Republicans’ push for dirty cars and trucks succeeds, it will
mean dirtier air, worse public health, and further enriching the oil executives
that profit from our higher costs at the pump. This move would break Senate rules and defy the Clean Air Act, endanger our
health, and be a catastrophe for our climate. We have to respond before the
Senate votes — and with just a slim Republican majority, we have a real shot at
stopping this attack on clean air and states’ rights in its tracks. We’re
working to mobilize nationwide — organizing protests, ensuring that every
senator has phones ringing off the hook and a full inbox, and rallying climate
champions in Congress. We need everyone who cares about clean air, public health, and the future of our planet to renew before the May 31 deadline. Even $5 makes a difference. https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/RZbkcR3~ Together, we can protect our air and climate from these attacks. Chris Brooks
