This markup went on for two days. Democrats offered many crucial amendments, including several of my own, to remove cruel and unnecessary changes to nutrition programs in this country. **I sat gavel to gavel and did not leave during the nearly 16-hour markup. The same can’t be said for my Republican colleagues, who didn’t even bother to show up for most of the hearing.** **Even with legislation that sought to cut $313 billion in SNAP funding, the largest cut to food assistance in American history, Republicans couldn’t even show up to defend their position. I remain committed to protecting SNAP and nutrition programs that millions of Americans rely upon.** The GOP legislation proposes cuts to programs like Meals on Wheels, SNAP, and more. It even includes a provision that lowers the age of a minor from 18 to 7 — so once a child turns 7, their parents are kicked off SNAP if they do not meet work requirements. That is unacceptable. But what’s even worse, these cuts do not pay down the debt in our country. _No — they are going toward tax cuts for billionaires._ Ever since I was elected to Congress, I have worked to keep nutrition programs fortified to make sure every family has access to nutritious meals. **[The fight continues, and I am hoping you can chip in a few dollars to help me keep up the work defending nutritional programs and more.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/107763435/545746350/-1534047261?refcode=AU_JH_FR_GEN_GEN_AC90_20250515_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82ODk4NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1NjRhMjZiYy1iZDMxLWYwMTEtYTVmMS02MDQ1YmRhOWQ5NmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=1Wi94V8MPx-qdqorSirzyl9H5pc2V4GRbTONNO8VM1I=)** _If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_ | | [$10 →](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/107763436/545746351/-1534047261?express_lane=true&amount=10&refcode=AU_JH_FR_GEN_GEN_AC90_20250515_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82ODk4NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1NjRhMjZiYy1iZDMxLWYwMTEtYTVmMS02MDQ1YmRhOWQ5NmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=1Wi94V8MPx-qdqorSirzyl9H5pc2V4GRbTONNO8VM1I=)

clean_body: | | Hi there, the House Committee on Agriculture just concluded our markup of the Republican reconciliation bill. This markup went on for two days. Democrats offered many crucial amendments, including several of my own, to remove cruel and unnecessary changes to nutrition programs in this country. I sat gavel to gavel and did not leave during the nearly 16-hour markup. The same can’t be said for my Republican colleagues, who didn’t even bother to show up for most of the hearing. Even with legislation that sought to cut $313 billion in SNAP funding, the largest cut to food assistance in American history, Republicans couldn’t even show up to defend their position. I remain committed to protecting SNAP and nutrition programs that millions of Americans rely upon. The GOP legislation proposes cuts to programs like Meals on Wheels, SNAP, and more. It even includes a provision that lowers the age of a minor from 18 to 7 — so once a child turns 7, their parents are kicked off SNAP if they do not meet work requirements. That is unacceptable. But what’s even worse, these cuts do not pay down the debt in our country. No — they are going toward tax cuts for billionaires. Recently, I sat on the Capitol steps and shared one of the most painful memories of my life: holding my husband Andy’s hand as he took his last breaths after a battle with cancer. That experience is why I will never stop fighting Republican attempts to cut access to health care. **Predictably, Stephen Miller jumped at the opportunity to distract his audience by using schoolyard taunts against me.** [](http://clicksp.frostforcongress.com/f/a/N7uE5uFZcPvoRKeciFKP9w~~/AAPPABA~/u9hrw6f8YenI085J3Mw959ZdGH3ln0JhKMwMbUmUSkQwQ_KK1NbXZ8IZ7SZcvrIXIpHotwWQDJ0VsJbSZlekbRub5zl3AfJTPc4nVx9_HC-oFhCuGp09aK6jNraj_N3EdD1Q9uT75zz3mxqDVn6_c3R0BwKG1jkM5l5B2kjXRhOUJLd2UsfJe5XpxVKeJRJd6GX3987_5udKlRrU6SJi0XFC2xe3_jaJVrqgsCe2ak_kWv0wobQImts_Eurk4QhDpeLOFs7tclWJMUhGiaCVlsSaHAtt9JqaNdNZ0YdxPpN95JqN7J-FgyJvt37F8uTi9WK30S55u4_7VQxHWf2y5gRd8z9Zg36tybHm5nILbC0~) **Notice what Stephen is doing here.** He doesn’t _actually_ care about women — men, _or_ anyone for that matter. | Friend,
As the legislature moves into the 2025-26 budget season, it is important that we renew our promise to you to remain vigilant stewards of your hardworking taxpayer dollars. The goal of this newsletter is to provide additional information on the legislative budget process so that you, as taxpayers, can remain informed about the workings of state government.
The budget process started in February when the Governor presented her Executive Budget to the House and Senate Appropriations Committees. Over the next few months, the House and Senate will work on their own versions of the budget outlining their spending priorities. The Appropriations Committee and subcommittees of the House and Senate will consider hundreds of individual spending requests from various legislators and departments in Michigan. Each chamber will then pass a budget that reflects the priorities of some or all members of that chamber. After the bills are passed by their respective chambers, they will then go to the other chamber for approval. It is likely they will wind up in a “conference committee” where any differences will be negotiated and included in a final version of the bill. The final version will then be passed by both chambers, without amendment, and that ultimately becomes the State of Michigan 2025-2026 budget.
It is a long process but we encourage you to follow along. We will continue to keep you updated as we move through the process and as things evolve.
We remain committed to fighting for Michiganders at every turn. That is why, just last week, Senate Republicans announced a new website where taxpayers can see every individual spending request submitted to be included in the budget. You can read more about the new website [here](https://brightsparkstrategies.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f3a7dccdb3ca90c7483cf93d3&id=699af0ffa8&e=9ec31248a9) and review budget requests [here](https://brightsparkstrategies.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f3a7dccdb3ca90c7483cf93d3&id=e1bdf5bf7d&e=9ec31248a9).
We continue to fight for transparency in the legislative process. We will remain vigilant.
In service,

headline reads "Democrats are failing against Trump. We need a new
generation in 2026", and the subhead reads "The absence of opposition has
been stunning. Americans are losing faith in the party's ability to solve
our problems"

Justice Democrats Executive Director Alexandra Rojas just had her newest
op-ed published today on the front page of The Guardian, and it’s an
important read.

It’s now been more than 100 days since Donald Trump returned to the White
House, and Democratic leaders like Chuck Schumer have utterly failed to
meet the moment.

In just the first three months of Trump 2.0, we’ve witnessed Trump,
billionaire Elon Musk and DOGE, and the rest of this far-right
administration take a chainsaw to the economy and our federal workforce,
our most basic constitutional rights, regulations that protect our
environment, health, and safety, and so much more.

But instead of fighting back tooth and nail at every step, blocking
nominees and must-pass spending bills, Democratic leaders have simply sat
back and watched, and in some cases even enabled it.

As Alex notes, the absence of true oppositional leadership has been
deafening. After spending an entire campaign cycle naming Trump as an
existential threat to our democracy and rule of law – which he is – the
party’s leadership has folded at the first chance to wield the power they
have, revealing hypocrisy and cowardice.

That’s why Justice Democrats is working to change that by recruiting and
supporting progressive, working-class leaders to challenge corporate,
Do-Nothing Democrats in the 2026 primaries.

Are we going to elect more multimillionaires backed by corporate lobbies
to play possum in the face of fascism, or are we going to elect people who
will fight to fix America’s crises with the urgency of someone who has
lived through them?

A new world needs new leaders. The 2026 cycle presents a historic
opportunity for generational and working-class transformation in the
Democratic Party and in our politics.

We just launched our first candidate of the cycle, Donavan McKinney in
Detroit, and we plan on more to come — but our ability to take on and
defeat the Democratic establishment depends directly on how much we raise
from grassroots supporters like you.

between Justice Democrats and our first new primary challenger of the
cycle, Donavan McKinney in MI-13, who is running to unseat a

If you're looking for a fun way to close the summer, look no further!

Virginia Moms for America is inviting you to attend their one-day summit at Regent University in Virginia Beach on Friday, August
1st. Come be encouraged and uplifted by messages of unity, light, and purpose offered by Moms for America’s founder and president,
Kimberly Fletcher, and Lead Cottage Meeting Instructor, Juleen Jackson. Dr. Kelly Kohls, the founder of the National Schoolboard
Leadership Council, will also attend to help concerned parents learn how to get involved with their local schoolboards from
general attendance to running for office.

Moms for America is dedicated to helping moms, future moms, and Grammy Grizzlies of all ages, circumstances, and demographics
learn to address and combat the negative influences infecting our modern culture. Come meet and mingle with like-minded women as
you learn what it is you can do for your Country, State, or County right from your own kitchen table!

Join us for an infusion of inspiration and encouragement!

clean_body: EARLY BIRD SPECIALS! Join Moms for America for a One Day Virginia Summit - Friday, August 1, 2025E If you are having trouble viewing this email click here to view in your browser. [] [] [] If you're looking for a fun way to close the summer, look no further! Virginia Moms for America is inviting you to attend their one-day summit at Regent University in Virginia Beach on Friday, August 1st. Come be encouraged and uplifted by messages of unity, light, and purpose offered by Moms for America’s founder and president, Kimberly Fletcher, and Lead Cottage Meeting Instructor, Juleen Jackson. Dr. Kelly Kohls, the founder of the National Schoolboard Leadership Council, will also attend to help concerned parents learn how to get involved with their local schoolboards from general attendance to running for office. Moms for America is dedicated to helping moms, future moms, and Grammy Grizzlies of all ages, circumstances, and demographics learn to address and combat the negative influences infecting our modern culture. Come meet and mingle with like-minded women as you learn what it is you can do for your Country, State, or County right from your own kitchen table! Join us for an infusion of inspiration and encouragement! [] [] SUMMIT LOCATION [] Regent University Library 1000 Regent University Drive Virginia Beach, VA * Prizes & Treats • Breakfast & Lunch Included Meet Like-Minded Moms CHECK OUT OUR EARLY BIRD REGISTRATION PRICES! REGISTER TODAY! [] Room Block If you’re looking for a convenient place to stay, look no further than the Founders Inn and Spa! Located right on Regent University’s beautiful campus, this Hilton-run property has a fabulous restaurant, two pools, a fitness center, and some of the best inland views available! Virginia Moms for America has a discounted room block available on a first-come-first-served basis until July 2nd. Rooms sell out fast, so book your stay today! Book Your Room Now! [] [] Take advantage of this opportunity to connect and rejuvenate with your peers, then enjoy the weekend with your family! Virginia Beach is a beautiful hub for various destinations including world-class beaches, Busch Gardens, Colonial Williamsburg, and much more. * We look forward to seeing you there! REGISTER TODAY! The FEC deadline isn’t just about numbers—it’s about showing our opponents, like Rep. Susie Lee with her massive war chest, that our grassroots energy can’t be outmatched.

We’re not relying on millionaires or special interests. We’re counting on patriots like you who believe in bringing common-sense leadership, creativity, and integrity to Washington. SIGN THE PETITION!!!

Secure the Child Tax Credit in the Reconciliation Bill – Support Working Families

Working families are being squeezed. Inflation has made it harder than ever to raise children in America. The Child Tax Credit
(CTC) – a commonsense, conservative policy – helps parents keep more of what they earn and provides vital tax relief when families
need it most.

The House Ways and Means Committee just took a step in the right direction:

* Raises the CTC to $2,500 through 2028

* Makes the $2,000 base credit permanent from 2029 forward, indexed to inflation

* Retains refundability for low-income earners

* Ensures the credit goes to eligible working families with valid Social Security numbers

Now it's up to CONGRESS to finish the job.

Why the CTC Matters:

* First introduced in the Contract with America, the Child Tax Credit is a pro-family, pro-work, and pro-growth solution.

* It strengthens households, rewards work, and returns tax dollars to parents.

* With rising prices on everything from groceries to childcare, families need this relief now more than ever.

* Protect and support the working families who are building America’s future

* Make the CTC stronger, permanent, and responsive to real economic needs

All I wanted to do was keep serving my country, the same way I have since I was sworn in to the U.S. Navy.
#

Team, when Gabby and I first agreed that I would run for Senate back in 2019, we knew things would change. We know more than most how public service can change your life.
But I’ve got to tell you, I never intended for things to end up like this. All I wanted to do was keep serving my country, the same way I have since I was sworn in to the U.S. Navy.
I know that service comes with risk, sure. But I didn’t set out to be called a traitor by the richest guy in the world, or to have one of Trump’s advisors calling for my execution.
Now, I don’t want you to worry about me. And after everything I’ve been through, things like this don’t intimidate me all that much.
I do worry that they will intimidate others, though — people just beginning to get involved. People thinking about joining a peaceful demonstration, or speaking out at a local town hall. I worry that Trump and his cronies are trying to scare people out of resisting him, and that it might be working.
But then I look back at this team. You’ve been with me a long time, and you haven’t backed down. Your support means the world to me, but it also gives me a lot of hope that enough people will stand up, push back, and make sure these guys don’t stay in power.
I’m ready to fight like hell to save our democracy. If you’re with me, please:

name: Ruben Gallego
subject: The Constitution
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Gallego for Arizona
body:
The president is selling off access to himself, to the White House, to his personal club down in Florida, to his golf courses, his hotels.
#

These guys just don’t get it.
[](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/signup/pet_em_corruption/?source=em250515-1-90&akid=3867%2E734936%2EAEsQ_H)
This isn’t complicated.
The president is selling off access to himself, to the White House, to his personal club down in Florida, to his golf courses, his hotels.
He’s taking personal gifts, campaign donations, investments in his companies and his crypto coins — even $400 million planes. In exchange, he’s ending investigations into potentially illegal behavior, he’s agreeing to arms deals, he’s doling out government contracts and jobs.
The corruption is absolutely breathtaking, and it has no parallel in modern history. Why?
**Because the founders banned this when they wrote the Constitution!** They knew, 250 years ago, that corruption would degrade our democracy.
This stuff is wrong. Anybody who hasn’t completely sold out to Trump can see that, and we can’t give it a pass.
[**Add your name and tell Congress to stop this and prevent the President of the United States from continuing these absolutely blatant acts of corruption. Please.**](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/signup/pet_em_corruption/?source=em250515-1-90&akid=3867%2E734936%2EAEsQ_H)

* **TOP NEWS**

"**SAPD Chief on thwarted school shooting plan: 'very disturbing things found**'," San Antonio Express-News' **Nancy M. Preyor-Johnson** and**Jacob Beltran** \-- "San Antonio Police Chief **William McManus** has revealed disturbing new details about a foiled school shooting plot at Rhodes Middle School -- and announced the case marks the first terrorism charge ever filed in Bexar County.

During a news conference Thursday morning, McManus said there were "very disturbing things found in the mother's house," though he didn't indicate what they were.

McManus also said investigators don't yet know if the boy was armed when he showed up to school with a mask and tactical gear.
[BECOME A PAID SUBSCRIBER: $7/mo](https://substack.com/redirect/7e025fb9-ebf4-4c8b-99fb-31df27cdd9b1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
He said that when**Ashley Pardo** was contacted by police, the school and Child Protective Services, she appeared "dismissive and unconcerned with her son's behavior."

"Her behavior is not only dangerous, it's abhorrent, especially as a parent," he said.

Pardo, 33, was arrested Monday and charged with aiding in the commission of terrorism. A judge set her bail at $75,000. She has been released on bond. Her 13-year-old son is charged with terrorism, officials said. He's being held at the Bexar County Juvenile Detention Facility.

She's accused of helping her son gather supplies as he planned to carry out a school shooting in San Antonio.

"This started with a tip, and we take every tip seriously," McManus said, adding that the case is being handled by the department's new Behavior Threat Assessment Group with the help of agencies across the city.

He said the boy and his mother would both have their day in court, and officers and partners in the community would work to protect the community.

On Monday, Pardo's son, a student at Rhodes Middle School, was arrested off-campus after the San Antonio Independent School District Police Department investigated online posts he had made, according to a letter sent to families by Principal **Felismina Martinez**." McManus also said investigators don't yet know if the boy was armed when he showed up to school with a mask and tactical gear. "Her behavior is not only dangerous, it's abhorrent, especially as a parent," he said. Pardo, 33, was arrested Monday and charged with aiding in the commission of terrorism. A judge set her bail at $75,000. She has been released on bond. Her 13-year-old son is charged with terrorism, officials said. He's being held at the Bexar County Juvenile Detention Facility. She's accused of helping her son gather supplies as he planned to carry out a school shooting in San Antonio. "This started with a tip, and we take every tip seriously," McManus said, adding that the case is being handled by the department's new Behavior Threat Assessment Group with the help of agencies across the city. He said the boy and his mother would both have their day in court, and officers and partners in the community would work to protect the community. "**SAPD Chief on thwarted school shooting plan: 'very disturbing things found**'," San Antonio Express-News' **Nancy M. Preyor-Johnson** and**Jacob Beltran** \-- "San Antonio Police Chief **William McManus** has revealed disturbing new details about a foiled school shooting plot at Rhodes Middle School -- and announced the case marks the first terrorism charge ever filed in Bexar County.

During a news conference Thursday morning, McManus said there were "very disturbing things found in the mother's house," though he didn't indicate what they were.

McManus also said investigators don't yet know if the boy was armed when he showed up to school with a mask and tactical gear.
[BECOME A PAID SUBSCRIBER: $7/mo](https://substack.com/redirect/ce95a11a-a0ce-4206-ab06-ef21bb9e2365?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
He said that when**Ashley Pardo** was contacted by police, the school and Child Protective Services, she appeared "dismissive and unconcerned with her son's behavior."

"Her behavior is not only dangerous, it's abhorrent, especially as a parent," he said.

Pardo, 33, was arrested Monday and charged with aiding in the commission of terrorism. A judge set her bail at $75,000. She has been released on bond. Her 13-year-old son is charged with terrorism, officials said. He's being held at the Bexar County Juvenile Detention Facility.

She's accused of helping her son gather supplies as he planned to carry out a school shooting in San Antonio.

"This started with a tip, and we take every tip seriously," McManus said, adding that the case is being handled by the department's new Behavior Threat Assessment Group with the help of agencies across the city.

He said the boy and his mother would both have their day in court, and officers and partners in the community would work to protect the community.

On Monday, Pardo's son, a student at Rhodes Middle School, was arrested off-campus after the San Antonio Independent School District Police Department investigated online posts he had made, according to a letter sent to families by Principal **Felismina Martinez**." McManus also said investigators don't yet know if the boy was armed when he showed up to school with a mask and tactical gear. He said that whenAshley Pardo was contacted by police, the school and Child Protective Services, she appeared "dismissive and unconcerned with her son's behavior." "Her behavior is not only dangerous, it's abhorrent, especially as a parent," he said. Pardo, 33, was arrested Monday and charged with aiding in the commission of terrorism. A judge set her bail at $75,000. She has been released on bond. Her 13-year-old son is charged with terrorism, officials said. He's being held at the Bexar County Juvenile Detention Facility. She's accused of helping her son gather supplies as he planned to carry out a school shooting in San Antonio. "This started with a tip, and we take every tip seriously," McManus said, adding that the case is being handled by the department's new Behavior Threat Assessment Group with the help of agencies across the city. He said the boy and his mother would both have their day in court, and officers and partners in the community would work to protect the community. On Monday, Pardo's son, a student at Rhodes Middle School, was arrested off-campus after the San Antonio Independent School District Police Department investigated online posts he had made, according to a letter sent to families by Principal Felismina Martinez." body:

[](https://link.email.freethinkerdaily.)
Friend,

I learned firsthand how our culture despises achievement and wishes to destroy anyone willing to challenge the status quo, big government, or the Fake News media machine.

When I was ousted from Project Veritas, two big things (one you haven’t heard about) happened to me.

FIRST: The media launched a vicious smear campaign against me like I’ve never seen before. **Make no mistake:** _They identified this as an opportunity to “cancel” me forever_ and tried everything in their power to destroy me and everything I’ve ever stood for.

They failed.

SECOND: I received an OVERWHELMING amount of support from patriots across the country. These brave men and women defended me, but more importantly, they stood up for the principles of liberty and free speech.

**One of my top supporters was The Atlas Society.**

Jennifer Grossman, the CEO of The Atlas Society, proudly stood by my side and even invited me to speak with a gathering of the organization’s top student leaders about free speech and how Howard Roark, the fictional hero of _The Fountainhead_ by Ayn Rand, remains my inspiration to act with integrity.

Which is why I am personally reaching out to you.

I told Jennifer I would help The Atlas Society raise $25,000 in the next 48 hours by personally contacting my online supporters. [Please consider making an URGENT donation of any amount to The Atlas Society by clicking here.](https://link.email.freethinkerdaily.)

[Donate >>](https://link.email.freethinkerdaily.)

Let me tell you more about The Atlas Society and how they are fundamentally changing the direction of our country.

_I will also tell you HOW The Atlas Society is spreading its message in what I consider one of the most innovative methods I’ve EVER seen a nonprofit organization engage in before._

_**_So keep reading_!**_

My mentor, Andrew Breitbart, reminds us that politics is downstream from culture. But what is culture downstream from? Answer: Philosophy. That’s where The Atlas Society shines, engaging young people with the virtues of reason, achievement, and benevolent self-interest in wildly creative, artistic ways.

Have you ever read Ayn Rand’s _Atlas Shrugged_ or _The Fountainhead_?

These books changed how I saw the world and my role in it.

But they are 700+ pages long!

**Jennifer shared this terrifying statistic with me:** Daily reading of books among young people has fallen from 70% in the late 1970s to 12% today.

So, how do we preserve Rand’s role as the greatest all-time recruiter for liberty? That’s where The Atlas Society gets creative! They leverage art and technology to create programming for “ _skimmers, swimmers, and deep divers_.”

**Skimmers:** Social media memes and animated videos — every single one of their 50 posts a week gets 40K comments, shares, and likes. The “Draw My Life” videos on concepts like Capitalism, Property Rights, and Free Speech reach MILLIONS of viewers. Links invite young people on a journey for deeper intellectual exploration.

**Swimmers:** Graphic novel adaptations of Ayn Rand’s shorter books, Pocket Guides that distill big concepts like Postmodernism and Socialism into a 90-minute read. Weekly podcasts with top entrepreneurs and thought-leaders, and discussion groups like “Morals & Markets.”

**Deep Divers:** They recruited an all-star academic faculty of philosophers and economists who guide students on a deeper study of Rand’s philosophy, publish independent work, and provide programming at their summer conference for students (the Galt’s Gulch Summit, where I spoke!).

Jennifer and The Atlas Society are accomplishing great things for our country, and I hope you will be one of the FIRST supporters of mine to make a donation and help me reach our $25,000 goal. Please use one of these links to donate:

[Donate $10 >>>](https://link.email.freethinkerdaily.)

[Donate $35 >>>](https://link.email.freethinkerdaily.)

[Donate $50 >>>](https://link.email.freethinkerdaily.)

[Donate $100 >>>](https://link.email.freethinkerdaily.)

[Donate $250 >>>](https://link.email.freethinkerdaily.)

[Donate $500 >>>](https://link.email.freethinkerdaily.)

[Donate $1,000 >>>](https://link.email.freethinkerdaily.)

[Donate Any Amount >>>](https://link.email.freethinkerdaily.)

Ultimately, here is what The Atlas Society is fighting FOR:
* Free market capitalism
* Rational self-interest
* Respect for achievement and success
* Free speech
* The future of young people and our great country

And here is what The Atlas Society is fighting AGAINST:
* Cancel Culture
* Our Educational system indoctrinating young people to embrace socialism
* Our sick culture that demonizes success and embraces twisted ideas
* Big government

I am inviting you to support The Atlas Society with a donation of ANY amount.

As a personal favor to me, please make your donation within the next 48 hours so I can help Jennifer reach our goal of $25,000.

[Here is the link to donate one more time.](https://link.email.freethinkerdaily.)

Thank you for everything,

James O’Keefe

P.S. Here is a picture of me speaking with The Atlas Society’s top student leaders.

[](https://link.email.freethinkerdaily.)
These students inspire me. Sadly, young people are learning to embrace socialism, reject critical thinking skills, and shed their creativity.

Well, NOT these students.

The Atlas Society is teaching students that they CAN accomplish great things, become leaders, and inspire others to do the same.

[Please take action by making a donation to The Atlas Society today. You can click here to donate $10, $50, $100, $500, $1,000, or ANY amount.](https://link.email.freethinkerdaily.)

Thank you,

clean_body: Swing district Republicans are terrified of voting for this bill. It’s official: in just a matter of days, the full House will vote on the GOP’s massive $700 billion cut to healthcare. If this Republican bill becomes law, millions of people will lose their healthcare all so that billionaires can get another tax break. That’s exactly what Trump and Mike Johnson want. But swing district Republicans are terrified of voting for this bill. They know it will hurt many of their constituents and could even cost them their jobs. They’re sharing their fears with their congressional colleagues, urging them to oppose cuts to Medicaid, and we can pile on the pressure to make voting to cut Medicaid so politically toxic that the Republican leadership goes back to the drawing board. Time is tight – the full House is getting ready to vote in days – but we can tip the scales. The Congressional Budget Office estimates the GOP plan would strip healthcare from at least 13.7 million people. These cuts would hit communities across the country and fund even more tax breaks for the ultra-rich. Members of Congress know that slashing Medicaid for their constituents could cost them their jobs. Widespread outcry already forced House leadership to walk back some of the most egregious proposals. But they’re still racing to find a way to slash hundreds of BILLIONS of dollars from the program so NOW is the moment to keep up the pressure. We don’t have much time – this fight will be won or lost in the next few weeks. We all need to add as much pressure as we can on Republicans in the House to save Medicaid by flooding Congress with messages to protect Medicaid before the full House vote. Thank you, The Care in Action Team

subject: They’re trying to take our rights back. Again.
body:

Hi Friend,
---
Missouri voters made it clear: government should **_stay out_** of private medical decisions. But instead of listening, Republican lawmakers passed HB73, legislation designed to overturn our vote, criminalize abortion care, and put our rights back on the chopping block. This bill uses deceptive ballot language to ban abortion, punish doctors, and even force survivors to report sexual assaults on a government timeline or risk jail time. It's cruel. It's extreme. And it's happening **_because people like Bob Onder want control_** --not just here in Missouri, but across the entire country. As a State Senator, Onder helped write Missouri's abortion ban. Voters overturned it. Now he wants to bring that same cruelty to Congress. And last night, he added insult to injury, announcing a virtual "town hall" with only 40 minutes' notice, after months of refusing to meet with constituents face-to-face. _**I believe in something very different**_ : that freedom includes the right to make our own healthcare decisions, that democracy means respecting the outcome of an election, and that leadership starts with listening--not hiding. We have to fight back. We have to fight back. I'm running for Congress to restore our rights and protect our freedom, but I can't do it without you. name: Katie Porter
subject: About Qatar gifting Trump a jumbojet
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Katie Porter for Governor 2026
body:
We need to have a serious conversation about presidential ethics.
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/21486?t=1&akid=39725%2E3422442%2EBiNb-u)
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_kp_20250515_1_ak?refcode=em20250515-39725&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=39725_3422442_BiNb-u&akid=39725%2E3422442%2EBiNb-u)
Derek, I don’t think I even need to explain why Trump accepting a luxury jet from a foreign government is a bad idea.
But here’s the thing: when I was in Congress, I saw this coming, and saw the corruption that already plagued Washington.
**That’s why just last year, I worked across the aisle to introduce legislation to strengthen presidential ethics requirements.** It would have mandated presidents and vice presidents disclose their gifts from foreign governments, their tax returns, and other information that could reveal conflicts of interest.
I said at the time that the bill wasn’t about targeting a particular person or candidate. High ethical standards for our elected officials should be something that every American can get behind, regardless of their party affiliation or ideology.
Too many politicians don’t see it that way.
**They’re quick to call out perceived corruption when it’s the other side doing it, but the same isn’t true when it’s their own party. That’s why my ethics bill never became law.**
Think about how many Republicans were shouting from the rooftops last year about presidential ethics. Where are they now that Trump wants to accept a jumbojet as a gift from a foreign government?
Too many of our elected leaders get tunnel vision because of party loyalty. The result is that legislation that would benefit all of us as Americans gets hindered to the point that it never becomes law.
**Just like when I was a Congressperson, my priorities as governor are going to be 100% what is in California’s best interest. I’ll work with everyone—and say no to anyone—to do what’s right for Californians.**

—Katie

Dear Fellow American,

I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter.

It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future.

A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution.

That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a National Survey on Presidential Selection.

By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue—views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders.

You can complete the National Survey on Presidential Selection by using the link below:

http://trk.victorymailings.com/?xtl=17x64w94u6ja38ibrg8xpm652nly8xv05djztosf1n593b4x3i1d6ns3bu3scwtupqzvhjay6wfdbdqckh6mh343gz4vevf9e6tmiectqd3h6qm49b6edefui8vpvz5ua41hjitm6sdp2mtpuhvgapey6z9f9g&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=swbmdr&__onlt=t
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=swbmdr&__onlt=t

Do you think that most Americans understand how the Electoral College works and its role in preserving free and representative government?

YES
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=swbmdr&__onlt=t

NO
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=swbmdr&__onlt=t

For most of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government.

But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.

This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics—too many Americans simply don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty.

Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching millions of Americans in all 50 states.

These efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of our schools, include:

Teaching millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"

Reaching over six million households and businesses nationwide with Imprimis, Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;

Promoting constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;

Sending millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America; and

Restoring excellence to K-12 education by helping establish and guiding classical K-12 schools nationwide and providing, free of charge, Hillsdale's American classical K-12 curriculum (including American civics) to thousands of American educators and homeschoolers.

Your answers to the National Survey on Presidential Selection will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty—including the importance of the Electoral College.

And this is especially important in this critical time for America's future.

So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our National Survey on Presidential Selection and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time.

You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:

http://trk.victorymailings.com/?xtl=17x64w94u6ja38ibrg8xpm652nly8xv05e7mveawl5j6n4fdtv83e6mqrrfapca1fig2lz57xybae3rmqc8kbqs7wtjairri1j67bdzrbd0y194ymnv8fn4sxrxmz9eumpcf7fk3c13ydz9g5hqiq3mn9k7tbo&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=swbmdr&__onlt=t
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=swbmdr&__onlt=t

And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift.

Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work.

Please represent your state and take the National Survey on Presidential Selection today. Thank you for your time and attention—and for your friendship and support of liberty.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn

President, Hillsdale College

Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

I hope you don’t mind me reaching out today, Peter. I wanted to make sure I personally sent along an update on the work we’ve been doing in Congress. I was proud to introduce the _HAVEN Act_ earlier this month — legislation that will secure housing as a human right by making sure that everyone has access to safe, affordable housing. This would lower housing costs for families as well as expand support for low-income families seeking assistance to obtain housing. I also called on the House Oversight Committee to address the staffing shortages that are impacting air travel and compromising the safety of passengers. And I have continued to call out Republicans for their greed and corruption, including in the Natural Resources Committee, where I highlighted Republicans who own stocks and have personal stakes in selling our environment to Big Oil — a discovery I made myself and exposed. This is just a small snapshot of all that my team and I are working on daily. This job is 24/7, and I feel immensely grateful for the opportunity to serve Arizona and our nation. **I can’t do this work without your support, Peter. Friend, Today marks the 77th year of the Israeli government’s ongoing Nakba against Palestinians. In 1948, the Israeli government ethnically cleansed 75% of Palestinians, forcing them from their homes, destroying hundreds of Palestinian villages and cities, and massacring tens of thousands of people. The brutal campaign to erase Palestinians from their homeland is ongoing. There are trucks lined up with food and medical aid that just need to come in, and the Israeli government is blocking them all. It’s time for my colleagues in Congress to end their silence. Many are OK with war crimes being committed against the Palestinian people. They make an exception for Palestinians’ human rights. They turn away and pretend it’s not happening. Trump Border Czar Tom Homan responded to Rep. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez's recent social media rant during a heated CNN interview.
**[He was not amused by her...](https://substack.com/redirect/5fde3907-2095-4aa6-b1a1-abb7030e2ce3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[Watch Video](https://substack.com/redirect/5fde3907-2095-4aa6-b1a1-abb7030e2ce3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[](https://substack.com/redirect/5fde3907-2095-4aa6-b1a1-abb7030e2ce3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Tapper claimed Homan, Executive Associate Director of Enforcement and Removal Operations, and the Trump administration is instilling fear even in legally residing immigrants.
"It is not okay to be in this country illegally. It's not okay to hire an illegal alien, because you're simply undercutting your competition who hires U.S. citizens," Homan slammed.
As for legal residents: **["We don't deport U.S. citizens."](https://substack.com/redirect/5fde3907-2095-4aa6-b1a1-abb7030e2ce3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
Homan continued, "You have certain rules when you get the resident alien card. You got to obey those rules. You can't violate the law, because even resident aliens can be deported if they commit certain felonies or misdemeanors...every resident who gets a green card knows what those rules are."
**["Simply follow the rules and don't break the law and you'll be just fine." ](https://substack.com/redirect/5fde3907-2095-4aa6-b1a1-abb7030e2ce3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
Tapper then brought up a threatening video made by Rep. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez following a physical protest at the ICE facility in New Jersey.
"If anyone's breaking the law in this situation, it's not members of congress, it's the Department of Homeland Security," AOC ranted. "It's people like Tom Homan and Secretary Christy Gnome. You lay a finger on...any of the representatives that were there, you lay a finger on them, we are going to have a problem."
Homan did not flinch at the flimsy threat.
**["You can't intimidate me. ](https://substack.com/redirect/5fde3907-2095-4aa6-b1a1-abb7030e2ce3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**Come on, give me a break! I was a green uniform, border patrol agent for five years before she was even born. I had more than three decades enforcing immigration law before she became a member of congress. I worked for six presidents."
Homan held nothing back, hammering AOC and Tapper unapologetically.
"This administration has done more to protect her district than she has!"
**["She's got to love her community more than she hates Trump](https://substack.com/redirect/5fde3907-2095-4aa6-b1a1-abb7030e2ce3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** because we're doing a lot to protect her community."

# RFK Jr. stands up to far-left Democrat looking to paint him as a "racist"
Health Secretary RFK Jr. **[clashed with far-left Democrat Rep. Bonnie Watson Coleman](https://substack.com/redirect/851f07d5-f484-4f37-ba9c-482752b2f05c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** when she accused him and the Trump administration of "racist" cuts to programs "to improve the lives of black Americans."
[Watch Video](https://substack.com/redirect/851f07d5-f484-4f37-ba9c-482752b2f05c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[](https://substack.com/redirect/851f07d5-f484-4f37-ba9c-482752b2f05c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
The confrontation occurred during a House Appropriations subcommittee hearing Wednesday.
"Few things enrage me more than the racist attacks I see this administration carrying out," Coleman started. "By embarking on an ignorant crusade to rid the government of any programs that are working to improve the lives of black Americans!"
Coleman listed several DEI-related buzzwords that the Trump administration recently removed from the operations of HHS to return the department to normalcy, including "race, bias, minority, oppression, prejudice, discrimination, disparity and racism."
"How exactly will HSS banning the words that we use to describe ourselves make us healthier?" Coleman asked Kennedy.
Kennedy explained that the Trump administration aimed to reflect the goals of Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. and **[have a"color blind" administration. ](https://substack.com/redirect/851f07d5-f484-4f37-ba9c-482752b2f05c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
Coleman did not appreciate his response and pressed on to further questioning. "The other thing that really troubles me, sir, is LIHEAP [Low Income Home Energy Assistance Program]," she continued. "It is a program specifically to address the needs of low-income and minority families as it relates to heating and even air conditioning. Why, why, why, why and what is your rationale for eliminating that program specifically? Why, why, why?"
Kennedy, maintaining composure, expressed support for LIHEAP, citing personal ties to low-cost fuel initiatives through his brother's nonprofit work. "I'm very committed to LIHEAP. My brother ran a..."
Coleman interrupted, dismissing Kennedy's past and focusing on his current role. "I care about your functioning in this department right now," she said.
**[Kennedy told the congresswoman that time had run out for questioning.](https://substack.com/redirect/851f07d5-f484-4f37-ba9c-482752b2f05c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** Coleman sharply concluded, "Your legitimacy has expired."

name: Deb Haaland
subject: A broken leg and 3 options
disclaimer_text: Paid for by The Long Run PAC, P
body:
A few years ago while visiting Shenandoah National Park, I took a bit of a tumble.
#
Friend, Deb Haaland here.
A few years ago while visiting Shenandoah National Park, I took a _bit_ of a tumble.
I was hiking up the side of a mountain when I slipped on a loose rock. It was a total freak accident — I couldn’t believe it! But there I was, covered in dirt with a pain in my leg and ankle and three options:
* Get airlifted down in a helicopter,
* take eight National Park staff away from their jobs to carry me down,
* or hike down myself.

**I chose to walk back down the mountain,** because I couldn’t stomach the idea of taking our National Park staff away from their work, even for a few hours. It turns out I hiked down all that way with a broken leg. I’ll be honest, I didn’t think my leg was actually broken at the time.
The federal workers who care for our public lands have absolutely crucial jobs to do. They preserve and protect our public lands for millions of visitors each year and for future generations. **Donald Trump and Elon Musk have made it clear they intend to auction off our lands to extractive industries like Big Oil. They’ve attempted to fire our dedicated National Parks and National Forests workers en masse.**
As Governor of New Mexico, I will be a fierce defender of our rivers, mesas, farmlands, and forests. I will always stand up for the dedicated workers who serve our communities. Republicans just handed over their anti-choice agenda (they're internally calling it "Rolling Thunder"). Here's what it includes:
* Banning safe, FDA-approved abortion pills like mifepristone
* Blocking online prescriptions and mail delivery of abortion medication through telemedicine
* Shortening the window for abortion access (in states with partial bans) from 10 weeks of pregnancy to just seven — before many people know they're pregnant
* Suing doctors and manufacturers in shield-law states who prescribe pills across state lines
* Stripping federal funding from organizations like Planned Parenthood

And they're already putting this plan into motion:
* Missouri Republican U.S. Sen. **Josh Hawley** just introduced a bill requiring in-person doctor visits for abortion medication, plus added surveillance.
* In a dog-whistle move, the FDA signaled it wouldn't challenge mifepristone unless "new data" emerged — so the GOP responded by immediately releasing a new junk science "report" riddled with misinformation from a right-wing think tank.

**First American Pope Elected!
What It Means for Latino Voters & U.S. Politics**
The Latino Vote Podcast Season 2025 Episode 14
| **"Habemus Papam. We have a new pope!"**
Chuck Rocha and resident Catholic expert Mike Madrid unpack the whirlwind election of the **first American Pope** —**Pope Leo XIV **— and explore what his ascendancy means for Latino culture, faith, and politics. From the storied rituals of white and black smoke in the Sistine Chapel to the surprising influence of betting markets on a secretive conclave, they shed light on the historical parallels between Pope Leo’s rapid three-round election and that of Pius XII in 1939.

President Trump wrapped up his middle east tour in the U.A.E. With over a trillion in new U.S. investments, President Trump reinvigorating relations with our allies in the middle east and took a gamble by lifting sanctions on Syria under the new leadership of President Ahmed al-Shara. Dan Crenshaw causes chaos amongst Democrats as he calls out their lies about Medicaid in Trump's "big, beautiful bill." CNN grifter Jake Tapper's new book "reveals" how President Biden did not recognize George Clooney at an event for his reelection in 2024. Rufus Gifford tells the truth about what actually went down. Between a shattered economy, an open border and being on the brink of WWIII, Biden's biggest sin to his elitist donor class was when he possibly didn't recognize George Clooney. It was another non-stop week and like all weeks, there were some winners and some losers...

Derek: Every year, on June 14, veterans and servicemembers across the country raise a glass to the U.S. Army on its birthday. Fun fact? The U.S. Army is celebrating its 250th birthday, making it one year older than the United States.
What’s the opposite of a fun fact? President Trump, in true Donald Trump fashion, is making this day about himself. His birthday is also on the 14th so he’s ordered a military parade from the Pentagon, running past the White House lawn, which will cost more than one hundred million dollars ... while at the same time is firing thousands of veterans across the government and slashing services for housing and healthcare that they’ve earned.
Not to mention selecting the deeply unqualified Pete Hegseth as his Secretary of Defense, someone who has recklessly and repeatedly put the lives of servicemembers at risk and undermined our own national security.
So let’s be clear. **This parade _cannot_ be both a celebration of Donald Trump's actions that directly harm our troops and veterans AND a celebration of our Army's service. **
That's why I'm saying "NO" to a military parade for President Trump's birthday – and I'm counting on you to join me, Derek. During this critical time, we need a surge of grassroots supporters like you to make your voice heard in support of our troops. **Will you add your name to our petition and say "NO" to a military parade for Trump's birthday?**

King David's momentous story provides profound insights into many of life's most important questions, including: What are my responsibilities to God? What do I owe my fellow man? How do I lead my family? How do I turn away from sin? What is the best way to lead others?

Taught by Hillsdale College Professor of English Justin Jackson, **" The David Story: Shepherd, Father, King"** examines the Old Testament books of First and Second Samuel. Fellow Conservative,

My name is Adam Schwarze, and _**I’m a former Navy SEAL Officer, Marine Corps vet, avid hockey player, and lifelong Minnesotan.**_ I know it’s early in the 2026 election cycle and you may not be paying attention to races in their infancy, like mine, still, I’m reaching out to you today to tell you a little about myself, who I am, and to make my case to earn your support in the upcoming battle I’m currently running headfirst into.

I’m running for the U.S. Senate against Tim Walz’s lieutenant governor, who, if you can believe it, **is politically more radical than the former VP nominee**.
**_
_**_People like the lieutenant governor were leading the violent unrest in Minneapolis in the summer of 2020._**_While the governor, whom the nation embarrassingly became acquainted with, eventually called for law and order in the street; his lieutenant governor was preparing a lawsuit against the Minneapolis Police Department for discrimination._**

The Minnesota I grew up in was far away from the world these two government officials call home.

As the son of two working-class parents, I have nothing in common with either my opponent or her boss, former VP candidate and Minnesota Governor Tim Walz.

I grew up playing hockey and joined the military on my 18th birthday in October 2001, less than two months after the horrific attack on New York, Pennsylvania, and Washington, D.C. Unlike Governor Walz, I was proud to deploy to over 70 countries in service to our nation;**I didn’t retire before being shipped out to serve our nation in war. I’ve willingly put myself into harm’s way more times than I can count in order to protect the American people, our shared conservative values, and our democratic way of life.**

I never imagined that I would run for high office, but _**everytime I came home from deployment things in Minnesota and the country seemed to have gotten worse because of the radical left policies.**_ I’m doing this because of the state of our current leadership. Minnesota is currently being led by two radical Democrats who have done their best to push this state as far left as anyone could tolerate.

**Something had to be done. **

With Sen. Tina Smith’s recent retirement announcement, now is a time to leap into the unknown—something I’ve done and found very fulfilling. While Minnesota hasn’t voted Republican in a presidential election since 1976, we’re not a deep blue state.

This election isn’t going to be an easy one for a Republican to win, but throughout my life and career I have always defied the odds. _**And as a former Navy SEAL and Marine Corps veteran, I excel in harsh environments - on and off the battlefield.**_

The simple truth is that I believe that my purpose in this life is to serve others, and I’m just a regular guy from Minnesota who was asked to do extraordinary things who wants to make my mom proud, serve my country, and do good by the people I meet. _— Marc Elias, May 9, 2025_ **This week** , a federal appeals court heard our appeal in **Fair Fight v. True the Vote** — where we’re holding an extreme anti-voter group accountable for trying to disenfranchise hundreds of thousands of voters ahead of the 2021 U.S. Senate runoffs in Georgia. True the Vote launched an effort to silence people who were disproportionately people of color and first-time voters with mass voter challenges, just weeks after Georgia flipped blue in a presidential election for the first time in 28 years. **But this case** is about more than just one election. It’s about more than one state. **This is about enforcing the Voting Rights Act and a national standard against voter intimidation to address a growing threat against vulnerable communities.** Mass voter challenges are spreading from state to state as a key tactic in the voter suppression playbook. Through this case, and through our broader work, we are exposing this coordinated anti-voter machine. There’s a nationwide network of political operatives, dark money, and right-wing organizations trying to make it harder for Americans — especially groups like voters of color, military voters, and students — to vote and have their voices heard, and they are not giving up any time soon. And don’t get it twisted, team. Bad actors are using these scare tactics and suppression efforts to _intentionally_ target communities of color. **It’s Jim Crow 2.0.** While it may not be a literacy test or poll tax, forcing voters to undergo any unreasonable hurdle to maintain their voter registration status after purging attempts is inherently anti-democratic and violates federal voting rights protections. **This case is so significant to our broader work against mass voter challenges. name: Haley Stevens
subject: My story and why I’m running
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Haley Stevens for Senate
body:
I’m ready to fight for the people that I love in the state that I love

| | | [](https://act.haleyformi.com/go/2606?t=1&akid=128%2E49239%2E4kO6Sj)
---
[](https://act.haleyformi.com/go/2607?t=2&akid=128%2E49239%2E4kO6Sj)
null – see that little girl in the photo? That’s me! Way before I had the honor of serving Michiganders in Congress and launching this battleground campaign to be Michigan’s next U.S. senator. I was about 12 or 13 years old there.
But don’t be fooled by school picture day (_and my trendy beaded necklace_). Growing up as the daughter of small-business owners – Mom and Dad had their own landscaping business – I was always around a lot of dirt, grease, grime, and heavy machinery. **I wouldn’t have had it any other way.**
My parents taught me the value of hard work – a value that binds all of us in Michigan together. After all, we’re the state that built America. The state that built the middle class.
In fact, do you know what one of my favorite memories is from growing up? When I got the keys to my first car, a used Oldsmobile Cutlass Supreme. That car represented the newfound freedom of teenage years. **But it was more to me than just that – it also meant I had a piece of Michigan.**
[](https://act.haleyformi.com/go/2607?t=3&akid=128%2E49239%2E4kO6Sj)
I love Michigan. I love the people here. And I love that I’ve been able to fight for my state in Congress. But as I’ve traveled our state recently, it’s clear that the people I love are afraid. They’re afraid because of the chaos and uncertainty that Donald Trump and Elon Musk are inflicting upon our nation.
All across our state, I hear concerns about rising costs, fear of uncertainty in our auto industry, and worries about the future of Social Security and Medicare. And you better believe people are outright disturbed by Trump’s attacks on our democracy and personal freedoms. **This fear, uncertainty, and chaos – all of it is**** _unacceptable._**
That’s why I’m running for U.S. Senate. I’m ready to fight for the people I love and help block Trump’s dangerous agenda. But the path to the Senate majority runs right through Michigan – and this battleground race is already being called a “Toss Up” by elections experts.

Hi,
You might recall that on his first day back in the White House, President Trump tried to attack U.S. citizens and trample over the Constitution by issuing an unconstitutional executive order to end birthright citizenship — and I immediately filed a lawsuit to stop him.
**Now, this critical fight for one of our most fundamental rights has made its way to the United States Supreme Court, where oral arguments were heard earlier today.**
The Trump administration is currently trying to overturn a lower court’s decision to issue a nationwide injunction and block the executive order from taking effect. Today’s hearing was an important milestone in this case, which can have massive consequences for our families, our communities, and our democracy as we know it. But, today was not the end of the road.
**I’m proud to stand together with my fellow attorneys general as we continue to defend the 14th Amendment, which guarantees citizenship for people born on U.S. soil or naturalized in our country.**
The Supreme Court settled this issue 127 years ago, and the law has been clear. Neither Trump nor any other president can rewrite the Constitution with the simple stroke of a pen.

| **Dear Friend,**
America’s future is on the line. I'm fighting for North Carolina’s 8th District and our shared values. **With a $37 trillion national debt, attacks on free speech, and reckless policies threatening our nation, we must act now.**

With President Trump’s leadership and a Republican Congress, we have a once-in-a-generation opportunity to enact bold reforms. I’m working tirelessly on the House Judiciary, Agriculture, and Education and Workforce Committees to advance an America First agenda—protecting our farmers, securing our borders, and ensuring our children are equipped with an education free from woke indoctrination. **Together, we can seize this historic moment to deliver real results for North Carolina and our nation. Thank you for standing with me.**

**Your contribution today will fuel our efforts to:**
* **Slash wasteful spending and tackle the deficit.**
* **Reform Medicaid to stop fraud and prioritize Americans.**
* **Extend Trump’s tax cuts to keep more money in your pocket.**
* **Protect free speech and stop foreign interference on campuses.**

**Donate $25, $50, or $100 Now**

The left is already mobilizing to block our reforms. Don’t let them drown out our voices. Chip in today to ensure we have the resources to fight back and win.
